zh: 模稜兩可的；含糊不清的
ex: The teacher's instructions were so {ambiguous} that half the class did the wrong page and the other half did nothing.
exz: 老師的指示太模稜兩可，結果一半同學寫錯頁，另一半什麼都沒寫。

ex: Living in Japan for two years helped her {acquire} a good command of Japanese and a love for its food.
exz: 在日本住了兩年，讓她學會流利的日語，也愛上了當地的食物。

fix: accomplish 是動詞「完成、達成」；「熟練的、有才藝的」是 accomplished。
ex: With the help of every team member, we {accomplished} the difficult task two days ahead of schedule.
exz: 在每位組員的協助下，我們提前兩天完成了這項困難的任務。

zh: 替代方案；可選擇的事物（adj. 替代的）
ex: Since the bridge was closed for repairs, drivers had no {alternative} but to take a much longer road around the lake.
exz: 由於橋梁封閉維修，駕駛們別無選擇，只能繞湖走一條遠得多的路。

zh: 令人愉快的；欣然同意的
ex: The weather was so {agreeable} that we decided to eat lunch outside under the trees instead of in the crowded cafeteria.
exz: 天氣十分宜人，所以我們決定在樹下吃午餐，而不是待在擁擠的餐廳。

ex: After eating the raw seafood, he felt a sharp pain in his {abdomen} and had to see a doctor right away.
exz: 吃了生海鮮後，他腹部一陣劇痛，必須馬上去看醫生。

ex: Students can enjoy free {admission} to the museum on Sundays if they show their student ID cards at the entrance.
exz: 學生週日只要在入口出示學生證，就能免費入場參觀博物館。

fix: academic 是形容詞「學術的、學業的」，中文要加「的」。
ex: Although his {academic} performance was only average, he was the best basketball player in the whole school.
exz: 雖然他的學業表現普通，卻是全校最好的籃球選手。

ex: Everyone watched with {admiration} as the old man finished the marathon, smiling and waving to the crowd.
exz: 大家欽佩地看著那位老先生跑完馬拉松，他還笑著向群眾揮手。

fix: adequately 是副詞「充分地、適當地」；「適當的、充分的」是形容詞 adequate。
ex: Many students fail the test not because they are lazy but because they have not {adequately} prepared for it.
exz: 許多學生考不好不是因為懶，而是因為準備得不夠充分。

ex: Before buying the apartment, we asked a real estate {agent} to show us several homes in the neighborhood.
exz: 買公寓前，我們請房屋仲介帶我們看了附近好幾間房子。

ex: She booked her trip to Spain through a travel {agency}, which also took care of her hotel and visa.
exz: 她透過旅行社訂了去西班牙的行程，旅行社也幫她處理飯店和簽證。

zh: 指控；控告（accuse A of B）
ex: The shop owner {accused} the boy of stealing a bottle of soda, but the camera later proved he had paid for it.
exz: 店主指控男孩偷了一瓶汽水，但監視器後來證明他有付錢。

ex: Without {adequate} sleep, students find it hard to pay attention in class and often make careless mistakes.
exz: 睡眠不足時，學生上課很難專心，也常犯粗心的錯誤。

zh: 認識的人；相識；（粗淺的）了解
ex: He is not really my close friend, just an {acquaintance} I have met a few times at the gym.
exz: 他不算是我的好朋友，只是在健身房見過幾次面的點頭之交。

zh: 適當的；合適的（v. 挪用、盜用）
ex: Jeans and T-shirts are not {appropriate} clothes for a formal wedding, so please wear a suit instead.
exz: 牛仔褲和T恤不適合穿去正式婚禮，所以請改穿西裝。

ex: My father joined the local parents' {association} so that he could help improve the school's lunch program.
exz: 我爸加入了當地的家長會，好幫忙改善學校的午餐計畫。

ex: You need your parents' written {approval} before you can join the school trip to Hong Kong next month.
exz: 你需要家長的書面同意，才能參加下個月的香港校外教學。

zh: 聯想；把…聯繫在一起（associate A with B）
ex: Many people {associate} the smell of fresh bread with warm memories of their grandmother's kitchen.
exz: 許多人會把新鮮麵包的香味和奶奶廚房的溫暖回憶聯想在一起。

ex: The doctor {assured} the worried parents that their son's injury was not serious and would heal in a week.
exz: 醫生向擔心的父母保證，他們兒子的傷不嚴重，一週內就會好。

zh: 任命；指派；約定（時間、地點）
ex: The company has {appointed} a young engineer as the new manager of its Taipei branch.
exz: 公司任命一位年輕工程師擔任台北分公司的新經理。

ex: It took us three hours to {assemble} the bookshelf because the instructions were written only in Swedish.
exz: 我們花了三小時才把書架組裝好，因為說明書只有瑞典文。

ex: Problems may {arise} if you sign a contract without reading every word of it carefully.
exz: 如果沒有逐字仔細閱讀就簽合約，可能會出問題。

ex: As a sign of {appreciation}, the students gave their retiring teacher a book filled with thank-you letters.
exz: 為表達感謝，學生們送給即將退休的老師一本寫滿感謝信的書。

ex: If you need any {assistance} with your luggage, please ask one of the staff members at the front desk.
exz: 如果您搬運行李需要任何協助，請洽詢櫃台的工作人員。

ex: The ancient stone {arch} at the entrance of the old town has survived three earthquakes and two wars.
exz: 古城入口那座古老的石拱門，歷經三次地震和兩場戰爭仍屹立不搖。

zh: 權力；權威（人士）；（the authorities）當局
ex: In our school, only the principal has the {authority} to cancel classes when a strong typhoon is coming.
exz: 在我們學校，只有校長有權在強颱來襲時宣布停課。

zh: 便宜貨；划算的交易（v. 討價還價）
ex: The leather jacket was only 500 dollars at the night market, which was a real {bargain}.
exz: 那件皮外套在夜市只賣五百元，真是撿到便宜。

ex: {Buddhism} is the religion followed in many temples in Taiwan, where visitors often see monks praying and burning incense.
exz: 佛教是台灣許多寺廟信奉的宗教，訪客常在寺裡看到僧侶祈禱、燒香。

ex: After buying the new phone, I was completely {broke} and had to borrow money from my sister for lunch.
exz: 買了新手機後，我身無分文，只好向姊姊借錢吃午餐。

ex: The {burglar} broke into the house through the kitchen window while the family was away on vacation.
exz: 那名竊賊趁一家人出外度假時，從廚房窗戶闖入屋內。

ex: The concert hall has a seating {capacity} of 2,000, but over 3,000 fans showed up on the first night.
exz: 音樂廳可容納兩千個座位，但首夜就來了超過三千名歌迷。

ex: We paddled the small {canoe} slowly down the river, watching birds and fish along the way.
exz: 我們慢慢划著小獨木舟順流而下，沿途觀賞鳥和魚。

ex: Hundreds of fans gathered at the airport to {await} the arrival of the famous Korean singer.
exz: 數百名粉絲聚集在機場，等待那位知名韓國歌手抵達。

ex: The {brutal} attack on the elderly man shocked the whole neighborhood, and the police quickly arrested the attacker.
exz: 那起對老人的殘暴攻擊震驚了整個社區，警方很快逮捕了攻擊者。

ex: Some farmers in Pingtung {breed} pigs and chickens and sell the meat to restaurants all over Taiwan.
exz: 屏東有些農夫飼養豬和雞，並把肉賣給全台各地的餐廳。

ex: Tom likes to {brag} about his rich father, but nobody in class is impressed by his stories.
exz: 湯姆喜歡炫耀他有錢的爸爸，但班上沒有人對他的故事感興趣。

ex: After washing the dishes, she puts all the plates and bowls back in the kitchen {cabinet} above the sink.
exz: 洗完碗後，她把所有盤子和碗放回水槽上方的廚房櫥櫃裡。

ex: When the main power failed during the storm, the hospital quickly switched to its {auxiliary} generator.
exz: 暴風雨中主電源故障時，醫院迅速改用備用發電機。

ex: She went to the department store to buy a new {bra} that fit better, along with some cotton socks.
exz: 她去百貨公司買一件更合身的新胸罩，還有幾雙棉襪。

ex: My uncle went {bald} in his thirties, so he always wears a cap when he goes out in the sun.
exz: 我叔叔三十幾歲就禿頭了，所以出門曬太陽時總戴著帽子。

ex: The hero spent ten years training hard so that he could {avenge} his father's death.
exz: 主角苦練十年，只為替父親的死報仇。

ex: Videos of police {brutality} against peaceful protesters spread quickly online and made many people angry.
exz: 警察對和平示威者施暴的影片在網路上迅速傳開，引起許多人憤怒。

ex: The engineers had to {modify} the design of the car after it failed several safety tests.
exz: 那輛車在幾次安全測試中失敗後，工程師必須修改設計。

ex: After months of fighting, both sides finally agreed to a {ceasefire} so that food could reach the starving people.
exz: 經過數月交戰，雙方終於同意停火，讓食物能送到挨餓的民眾手中。

ex: Members of the {clergy}, such as priests and ministers, led the prayers at the national ceremony.
exz: 神職人員，例如神父和牧師，在國家典禮上帶領眾人祈禱。

ex: The teacher drew a simple chart on the board to {clarify} the difference between the two grammar rules.
exz: 老師在黑板上畫了一張簡單的圖表，來釐清兩個文法規則的差異。

ex: The artist used a sharp knife to {carve} a beautiful bird out of a single piece of wood.
exz: 藝術家用一把鋒利的刀，從一整塊木頭雕出一隻美麗的鳥。

ex: Many {civilians}, including women and children, were killed when the bombs fell on the small village.
exz: 炸彈落在小村莊時，許多平民喪生，其中包括婦女和兒童。

ex: As a successful {capitalist}, he believed that free markets and competition would make everyone richer.
exz: 身為成功的資本家，他相信自由市場與競爭能讓每個人更富裕。

zh: 房間；（議會的）議院；（身體的）腔室
ex: The king received foreign visitors in a large {chamber} decorated with gold and red curtains.
exz: 國王在一間以金色與紅色簾幕裝飾的大廳裡接見外國訪客。

ex: Under no {circumstances} should you open the door to strangers when your parents are not at home.
exz: 父母不在家時，無論如何都不能開門讓陌生人進來。

ex: Scientists {classify} animals into groups, such as mammals, birds, and reptiles, based on their features.
exz: 科學家根據動物的特徵，把牠們分成哺乳類、鳥類和爬蟲類等類別。

fix: Catholic（大寫）是「天主教的」；小寫 catholic 才有「廣泛的、包羅萬象的」之意，且很少用。
ex: {Catholic} churches around the world hold Mass every Sunday, and many follow the teachings of the Pope in Rome.
exz: 世界各地的天主教教堂每週日都舉行彌撒，許多教會遵循羅馬教宗的教導。

zh: 衝突；（意見）分歧；（顏色）不搭
ex: A {clash} between the two groups of fans broke out after the match, and several people were injured.
exz: 比賽結束後，兩群球迷爆發衝突，好幾個人受傷。

zh: 全心投入的；堅定的；忠誠的
ex: She is a {committed} volunteer who has visited the children's hospital every weekend for five years.
exz: 她是一位全心投入的志工，五年來每個週末都去兒童醫院探訪。

ex: The hikers stood at the edge of the {cliff} and looked down at the waves crashing against the rocks below.
exz: 健行者站在懸崖邊，往下看著海浪拍打下方的岩石。

ex: In a country based on {capitalism}, most businesses are owned by private individuals rather than by the government.
exz: 在以資本主義為基礎的國家，大部分企業由私人而非政府擁有。

ex: My {clumsy} little brother broke two glasses and spilled milk all over the table during breakfast.
exz: 我笨手笨腳的弟弟吃早餐時打破兩個杯子，還把牛奶灑了滿桌。

ex: {Christian} families around the world celebrate Christmas as the birth of Jesus, and many of them go to church that day.
exz: 世界各地的基督徒家庭把聖誕節當作耶穌的誕辰來慶祝，許多人當天會上教堂。

ex: I looked through the online {catalogue} and ordered a pair of shoes and a warm winter coat.
exz: 我瀏覽了線上型錄，訂了一雙鞋和一件保暖的冬季外套。

ex: I will always {cherish} the memories of the summer we spent together at Grandma's farm.
exz: 我會永遠珍惜我們一起在奶奶農場度過的那個夏天的回憶。

ex: The blanket was made of {coarse} wool, so it felt rough and itchy against my skin.
exz: 那條毯子是用粗羊毛做的，貼在皮膚上感覺又粗又癢。

fix: cease 是動詞「停止」；「珍惜」是 cherish，兩字容易搞混。
ex: Because of falling sales, the old factory {ceased} production last year, and hundreds of workers suddenly lost their jobs.
exz: 由於銷量下滑，那家老工廠去年停產，數百名工人突然失業。

ex: The port city became a center of {commerce}, where traders from many countries bought and sold goods.
exz: 這座港口城市成為商業中心，來自各國的商人在此買賣貨物。

ex: In this year's contest, students can enter their stories in either the fiction or the poetry {category}.
exz: 在今年的比賽中，學生可以把作品投稿到小說類或詩類。

ex: Before sharing news online, you should {verify} the facts by checking at least two reliable sources.
exz: 在網路上分享新聞前，你應該查看至少兩個可靠來源來核實事實。

zh: 恭喜；祝賀（congratulate sb on sth）
ex: All her classmates came over to {congratulate} her on winning first prize in the speech contest.
exz: 全班同學都過來恭喜她在演講比賽得到第一名。

ex: He is {content} with a simple life and does not care about fame or expensive cars at all.
exz: 他滿足於簡單的生活，完全不在乎名聲或昂貴的車子。

ex: The company hired a financial {consultant} to help it reduce costs and plan for the future.
exz: 公司聘請一位財務顧問，幫忙降低成本並規劃未來。

ex: According to the latest report, women now {constitute} more than half of the students in this university's medical school.
exz: 根據最新報告，女性目前占這所大學醫學院學生的一半以上。

fix: consistently 是副詞「一貫地、持續地」；「一致的」是形容詞 consistent。
ex: She has {consistently} ranked first in her class, so her teachers were not surprised when she got into NTU.
exz: 她一直穩居班上第一，所以她考上台大時老師們並不意外。

ex: He had a guilty {conscience} after lying to his mother, so he finally told her the truth.
exz: 他對媽媽說謊後良心不安，最後還是告訴她實話。

ex: If you keep staying up late every night, you will have to face the {consequences} of poor health.
exz: 如果你每晚都熬夜，就得承受健康變差的後果。

zh: 隨之而來的；因而產生的
fix: consequent 指「隨之發生的、因此產生的」，不是「必然的」（必然的是 inevitable）。
ex: The heavy rain and the {consequent} flooding forced many families in the area to leave their homes.
exz: 大雨以及隨之而來的水災，迫使該地區許多家庭離開家園。

zh: 保守的；（估計）保守的、謹慎的
ex: My grandparents are quite {conservative} and think young people should not get tattoos or dye their hair.
exz: 我爺爺奶奶相當保守，認為年輕人不應該刺青或染頭髮。

ex: Please don't {complicate} the plan by inviting more people; we only have one car and five seats.
exz: 請別再邀更多人把計畫弄複雜了，我們只有一輛車、五個座位。

zh: 連接詞；結合（in conjunction with 與…一起）
ex: Words like "and," "but," and "because" are common {conjunctions} that join words or parts of a sentence together.
exz: 像 and、but、because 這類字是常見的連接詞，用來連接單字或句子的各部分。

ex: According to the {constitution}, every citizen has the right to vote and the freedom of speech.
exz: 根據憲法，每位公民都享有投票權與言論自由。

ex: Young children often find it hard to understand the {concept} of time, such as the difference between a week and a month.
exz: 幼童通常很難理解時間的概念，例如一週和一個月的差別。

ex: The roads near the train station are always {congested} during rush hour, so I usually ride my bike instead.
exz: 火車站附近的道路在尖峰時段總是很塞，所以我通常改騎腳踏車。

ex: If the pain does not go away in three days, you should {consult} a doctor instead of guessing online.
exz: 如果三天內疼痛沒消退，你應該去看醫生，而不是上網亂猜。

ex: The {conductor} raised his hands, and the whole orchestra began to play the first notes of the symphony.
exz: 指揮舉起雙手，整個管弦樂團開始演奏交響曲的第一個音符。

zh: 組成成分；作文；（音樂）作品
ex: Scientists studied the chemical {composition} of the rock and found that it contained a large amount of iron.
exz: 科學家研究這塊岩石的化學成分，發現其中含有大量的鐵。

ex: With the help of her coach, she finally {conquered} her fear of water and learned to swim.
exz: 在教練的幫助下，她終於克服了對水的恐懼，學會了游泳。

ex: The bill was passed by the national {congress} after months of heated debate among lawmakers from different parties.
exz: 經過不同政黨議員數月的激烈辯論，該法案在國會獲得通過。

zh: 擔心；關心的事（v. 使擔心；涉及）
ex: In recent years, air pollution has become a major {concern} for parents whose young children suffer from asthma.
exz: 近年來，空氣污染已成為孩子患有氣喘的家長們的一大憂慮。

ex: Instead of a {conventional} wedding in a hotel, they got married on a mountain top with only ten friends.
exz: 他們沒有在飯店辦傳統婚禮，而是只帶十位朋友在山頂結婚。

ex: Please pay at the {counter} near the door before you take your coffee to the table.
exz: 拿咖啡到座位前，請先到門邊的櫃台付款。

zh: 躡手躡腳地走；緩慢爬行（crept, crept）
ex: The cat {crept} quietly toward the bird, keeping its body low so that it would not be noticed.
exz: 貓壓低身體，悄悄朝那隻鳥爬過去，以免被發現。

ex: Smoking and lack of exercise both {contribute} to heart disease, so doctors advise people to change their habits.
exz: 抽菸與缺乏運動都會導致心臟病，所以醫生建議大家改變習慣。

ex: She put a soft {cushion} behind her back because the wooden chair was hard and uncomfortable.
exz: 她在背後放了一個軟墊，因為那張木椅又硬又不舒服。

zh: 確信的；深信的（be convinced that/of）
ex: After seeing the evidence, the jury was {convinced} that the man was guilty and sent him to prison.
exz: 看過證據後，陪審團確信那名男子有罪，將他送進監獄。

ex: We rented a small {cottage} by the lake and spent a quiet weekend fishing and reading.
exz: 我們在湖邊租了一間小屋，度過一個釣魚、看書的寧靜週末。

zh: 禮貌；好意；（by courtesy of）承蒙
ex: It is a common {courtesy} to hold the door open for the person walking behind you.
exz: 替走在後面的人扶著門，是基本的禮貌。

fix: 中文是「旋風」不是「炫風」；精確說是熱帶「氣旋」（印度洋稱 cyclone，西太平洋稱颱風 typhoon）。
ex: A powerful {cyclone} hit the coast of India, destroying thousands of homes with strong winds and heavy rain.
exz: 一個強烈氣旋侵襲印度沿海，強風豪雨摧毀了數千戶房屋。

ex: Be careful not to trip over the long power {cord} that runs from the TV to the wall.
exz: 小心別被那條從電視拉到牆邊的長電線絆倒。

ex: It took me a whole week to {convince} my parents to let me go camping with my friends.
exz: 我花了整整一週才說服爸媽讓我和朋友去露營。

zh: 相反（on the contrary 正好相反）；相反的
ex: The test was not easy; on the {contrary}, it was the hardest one we have taken this year.
exz: 那次考試一點也不簡單；恰恰相反，那是我們今年考過最難的一次。

ex: The two old friends sat in the café and {conversed} for hours about their school days.
exz: 兩位老朋友坐在咖啡店裡，聊了好幾個小時學生時代的事。

ex: Many first-year college students find it hard to {cope} with living away from home for the first time.
exz: 許多大一新生覺得第一次離家生活很難應付。

ex: The {cunning} fox pretended to be hurt so that the hunters would follow it away from its babies.
exz: 狡猾的狐狸假裝受傷，引誘獵人跟著牠遠離幼崽。

ex: The city {council} voted to build a new park in the area where the old factory used to stand.
exz: 市議會投票決定在舊工廠原址興建一座新公園。

ex: The film received bad reviews from most {critics}, but audiences loved it and it made a lot of money.
exz: 這部電影獲得大部分影評人的負評，但觀眾很喜歡，票房賺了很多錢。

zh: 奉獻；致力於（devote oneself / time to）
ex: She decided to {devote} her life to helping homeless children in the poorest parts of the city.
exz: 她決定把一生奉獻給幫助城市最貧困地區的無家可歸兒童。

zh: 沮喪的；憂鬱的；（經濟）蕭條的
ex: He felt {depressed} for weeks after failing the exam, and he hardly spoke to anyone at home.
exz: 他考試失利後消沉了好幾週，在家幾乎不跟任何人說話。

zh: 忠誠的；全心投入的（be devoted to）
ex: He is a {devoted} father who has never missed any of his daughter's piano concerts, even when he is very busy.
exz: 他是位盡心的父親，即使再忙，也從未錯過女兒任何一場鋼琴演奏會。

zh: 易碎的；精緻的；（處境）微妙的
ex: Please handle the glass vase with care, as it is very {delicate} and can break easily.
exz: 請小心拿這個玻璃花瓶，它很脆弱，很容易破。

zh: 憂鬱（症）；沮喪；（經濟）不景氣
ex: After losing her job, she suffered from {depression} and needed help from a doctor to feel better.
exz: 丟了工作後，她罹患憂鬱症，需要醫生協助才好轉。

ex: You have worked so hard all year, so you really {deserve} a long holiday by the sea.
exz: 你一整年都這麼努力，真的值得到海邊好好放個長假。

ex: Even though he was poor, the old man refused to beg and kept his {dignity} until the end.
exz: 雖然貧窮，那位老人拒絕乞討，直到最後都保有尊嚴。

zh: 使有尊嚴；使顯得高貴（dignify sth with a reply 抬舉…而回應）
ex: The minister refused to {dignify} the rude question with a reply, saying it did not deserve any answer at all.
exz: 部長拒絕回應那個無禮的問題，表示它根本不值得回答。

ex: In the early morning, the grass was covered with {dew}, and my shoes got wet as I walked across the field.
exz: 清晨草地上覆滿露水，我走過田野時鞋子都濕了。

zh: 佳餚；美食；精緻；（處境）微妙
ex: Stinky tofu is a famous Taiwanese {delicacy}, though many foreign visitors cannot stand its strong smell.
exz: 臭豆腐是台灣有名的美食，不過許多外國遊客受不了它濃烈的氣味。

ex: It takes our stomach several hours to {digest} a big meal, so don't go swimming right after eating.
exz: 胃要花好幾個小時才能消化一頓大餐，所以吃飽後別馬上去游泳。

zh: 絕望的；極度渴望的；不顧一切的
ex: After being lost in the mountains for three days, the hikers were {desperate} for food and water.
exz: 在山裡迷路三天後，登山客極度渴望食物和水。

ex: The students {devised} a clever plan to collect rainwater and use it to water the school garden.
exz: 學生們想出一個聰明的方法，收集雨水來澆灌學校的花園。

ex: The strong earthquake caused great {destruction} in the city, leaving thousands of families without homes for months.
exz: 強烈地震對城市造成嚴重破壞，數千個家庭好幾個月無家可歸。

ex: The {dense} fog on the highway made it impossible for drivers to see more than ten meters ahead.
exz: 高速公路上的濃霧讓駕駛人看不到十公尺以外的地方。

ex: My clothes still felt {damp} after hanging outside all day because the weather was cloudy and humid.
exz: 衣服在外面晾了一整天還是濕濕的，因為天氣陰沉又潮濕。

ex: After the teacher pointed out several mistakes, I {revised} my essay and handed it in again.
exz: 老師指出幾個錯誤後，我修改了作文再交一次。

ex: It was {obvious} from her red eyes that she had been crying for a long time.
exz: 從她紅紅的眼睛看得出來，她顯然哭了很久。

zh: 失敗；（電影等）慘敗（v. 失敗；重重坐下）
ex: The movie cost 100 million dollars to make, but it was a total {flop} and very few people went to see it.
exz: 那部電影花了一億美元拍攝，卻徹底失敗，很少人去看。

ex: In ancient times, people believed that kings had {divine} power given to them directly by the gods.
exz: 古時候人們相信，君王擁有眾神直接賜予的神聖權力。

ex: Please do not {disturb} your sister; she is studying for her final exams in her room.
exz: 請不要打擾你姊姊，她正在房間裡準備期末考。

ex: Our new English teacher is young and {dynamic}, and her lively classes are never boring.
exz: 我們的新英文老師年輕又充滿活力，她生動的課從不無聊。

ex: She proudly walked across the stage to receive her high school {diploma} from the principal.
exz: 她驕傲地走過舞台，從校長手中接過高中畢業證書。

zh: 紀律；自律；訓練；學科（v. 管教）
ex: Learning to play the violin well takes years of {discipline} and hours of practice every day.
exz: 要把小提琴拉好，需要多年的自律以及每天好幾小時的練習。

ex: She is a {diligent} student who reviews her notes every night and never misses an assignment.
exz: 她是個勤奮的學生，每晚複習筆記，從不缺交作業。

fix: diversity 是名詞「多樣性」；「多樣的、多元的」是形容詞 diverse。
ex: The rainforest is famous for its {diversity} of plants and animals, many of which cannot be found anywhere else.
exz: 熱帶雨林以動植物的多樣性聞名，其中許多是在其他地方找不到的。

zh: 卓越的；著名的；（外表）高貴的
ex: The {distinguished} scientist has won many international awards for her research on cancer treatment over the past thirty years.
exz: 這位傑出的科學家過去三十年因癌症治療研究獲得許多國際大獎。

ex: Volunteers {distributed} free masks and hand sanitizer to people at the train station during the outbreak.
exz: 疫情爆發期間，志工在火車站分發免費口罩和乾洗手給民眾。

ex: Her {diligence} paid off when she passed the exam and got into the university of her dreams.
exz: 她的勤奮有了回報：她通過考試，進了夢想中的大學。

zh: 爭端；爭執（v. 爭論；質疑）
ex: The two neighbors had a long {dispute} over who owned the small piece of land between their houses.
exz: 兩位鄰居為了兩家之間那塊小地歸誰，爭執了很久。

fix: earnestly 是副詞「認真地、誠懇地」；「認真的」是形容詞 earnest。
ex: With tears in his eyes, the boy {earnestly} promised his mother that he would never lie to her again.
exz: 男孩眼中含淚，誠懇地向媽媽保證再也不會對她說謊。

zh: 使氣餒；勸阻（discourage sb from V-ing）
ex: The heavy rain did not {discourage} the fans from waiting outside the stadium for hours.
exz: 大雨並沒有讓球迷打消在體育場外苦等好幾個小時的念頭。

zh: 閃避；躲避；逃避（責任、問題）
ex: The boy quickly {dodged} the flying ball, so it missed him and hit the wall behind him instead.
exz: 男孩迅速閃過飛來的球，所以球沒打中他，而是打到他身後的牆。

ex: He made an {earnest} effort to improve his English by reading a news article every morning.
exz: 他每天早上讀一篇新聞，認真努力地提升英文。

ex: Many students {dread} the first day after summer vacation because they have to get up early again.
exz: 許多學生很怕暑假後的第一天，因為又得早起了。

ex: Many famous Chinese poems were written during the Tang {dynasty}, which lasted for nearly three hundred years.
exz: 許多著名的中國詩歌寫於唐朝，這個朝代延續了將近三百年。

ex: These hiking boots are expensive, but they are very {durable} and can last for many years.
exz: 這雙登山靴雖然貴，但非常耐用，可以穿很多年。

zh: 演習；操練；鑽頭（v. 鑽孔；反覆練習）
ex: During the fire {drill}, all the students left the classroom calmly and gathered on the playground.
exz: 消防演習時，全體學生冷靜地離開教室，到操場集合。

ex: Taiwan has a {diverse} population, including Han Chinese, indigenous peoples, and new immigrants from Southeast Asia.
exz: 台灣的人口組成多元，包括漢人、原住民和來自東南亞的新住民。

zh: 有彈性的；有伸縮性的；靈活的
fix: 拼字錯誤：應為 elastic；中文「有彈性的」正確。
ex: The waist of these pants is {elastic}, so they fit comfortably even after I eat a big dinner.
exz: 這條褲子的腰圍有彈性，所以即使我吃完大餐也穿得很舒服。

ex: Although the two phones look different, they are {essentially} the same, with the same camera and battery.
exz: 雖然這兩支手機外觀不同，但本質上是一樣的，相機和電池都相同。

ex: The police will strictly {enforce} the new law, and drivers who use their phones will be fined.
exz: 警方將嚴格執行新法，開車使用手機的駕駛會被罰款。

ex: After sleeping through the long, cold winter, the bears finally {emerge} from their caves to look for food.
exz: 睡過漫長寒冷的冬天後，熊終於從洞穴出來覓食。

ex: Teachers {evaluate} students not only by test scores but also by their class participation and projects.
exz: 老師評量學生不只看考試分數，也看課堂參與和專題作業。

ex: Our school puts great {emphasis} on English speaking, so we have a conversation class every day.
exz: 我們學校非常重視英語口說，所以每天都有會話課。

ex: Don't {exaggerate}! The fish you caught was not as big as a car; it was only the size of my hand.
exz: 別誇張了！你釣到的魚哪有車子那麼大，只有我手掌那麼大而已。

zh: 被淘汰；被消除（eliminate 的過去式／過去分詞）
fix: eliminate 是「消除、淘汰」，不是「殲滅」（殲滅是 wipe out）；eliminated 多指「被淘汰」。
ex: Our team was {eliminated} in the first round of the tournament, so we went home earlier than expected.
exz: 我們隊在第一輪就被淘汰了，所以比預期早回家。

ex: Nobody expected the young player to be the {eventual} winner of the tournament, but she beat every opponent.
exz: 沒人料到這位年輕選手會是錦標賽的最終贏家，但她擊敗了每一位對手。

ex: Malaysia is home to several {ethnic} groups, including Malays, Chinese, and Indians, each with its own language.
exz: 馬來西亞有好幾個民族，包括馬來人、華人和印度人，各有自己的語言。

ex: Strict {enforcement} of the speed limit has greatly reduced the number of traffic accidents in this area.
exz: 嚴格執行速限，大幅減少了這一區的交通事故。

ex: The {enthusiastic} fans cheered and sang loudly throughout the whole concert, even though it was raining heavily.
exz: 雖然下著大雨，熱情的歌迷仍在整場演唱會中大聲歡呼、歌唱。

ex: The new teacher received a positive {evaluation} from both students and parents at the end of the semester.
exz: 學期末，新老師獲得學生與家長的正面評價。

ex: The photo is too small to see clearly, so let's {enlarge} it on the computer screen.
exz: 照片太小看不清楚，我們在電腦螢幕上把它放大吧。

ex: Experts {estimate} that the new stadium will cost about two billion dollars and take five years to build.
exz: 專家估計新體育場將花費約二十億元、耗時五年建成。

ex: The {farsighted} mayor planted thousands of trees thirty years ago, and now the city enjoys cool, shady streets.
exz: 有遠見的市長三十年前種了上千棵樹，如今城市享有涼爽、綠蔭的街道。

ex: The {faithful} dog waited at the train station every day for its owner, even years after he died.
exz: 那隻忠心的狗每天在火車站等主人，即使在主人過世多年後仍是如此。

zh: 花費；耗費（時間、精力、金錢）
ex: The government has {expended} a great deal of money and effort on cleaning up the polluted river.
exz: 政府已投入大量金錢與心力整治這條受污染的河川。

fix: farewell 是「告別、送別」，不是「告白」（告白是 confess one's love）。
ex: We held a {farewell} party for our English teacher, who was moving back to Canada after ten years in Taiwan.
exz: 我們為在台灣待了十年、即將搬回加拿大的英文老師辦了一場送別派對。

ex: The {favorable} weather allowed the farmers to harvest their rice two weeks earlier than usual.
exz: 有利的天氣讓農夫比平常提早兩週收割稻米。

ex: Scientists study the {formation} of clouds to better predict when and where it will rain.
exz: 科學家研究雲的形成，以便更準確地預測何時何地會下雨。

fix: flatter 是動詞「奉承、討好」，不是形容詞「討好的」；形容詞「討好的、恭維的」是 flattering。
ex: He tried to {flatter} the boss by praising her terrible jokes, hoping to get a promotion.
exz: 他想拍老闆馬屁，稱讚她很爛的笑話，希望能升職。

fix: extend 是動詞「延長、延伸」；「範圍、程度」是名詞 extent（如 to some extent）。
ex: To help students prepare, the library has {extended} its opening hours until midnight during the final exam period.
exz: 為了幫助學生準備考試，圖書館在期末考期間把開放時間延長到午夜。

ex: According to the weather {forecast}, a strong typhoon will hit northern Taiwan tomorrow afternoon, so classes may be canceled.
exz: 根據氣象預報，強颱明天下午將侵襲北台灣，所以可能會停課。

ex: The driver was going too fast on the wet road, and the accident turned out to be {fatal}.
exz: 那位駕駛在濕滑的路上開太快，結果那場車禍釀成死亡。

ex: On school nights, my parents {forbid} me to play video games until I have finished all my homework.
exz: 上學日的晚上，爸媽禁止我在寫完所有作業前打電動。

ex: The Spanish built a {fort} on the hill in Tamsui to protect the harbor from enemy ships.
exz: 西班牙人在淡水的山丘上建了一座堡壘，保護港口不受敵船侵擾。

fix: favorably 是副詞「有利地、贊同地」；「有利的」是形容詞 favorable。
ex: Most viewers responded {favorably} to the new drama, and its ratings kept rising every week.
exz: 多數觀眾對新劇反應良好，收視率每週都在上升。

zh: 肥沃的；能生育的；（想像力）豐富的
ex: The land along the river is very {fertile}, so farmers can grow rice there twice a year.
exz: 河邊的土地非常肥沃，所以農夫一年可以種兩期稻作。

ex: When the huge waves crashed against the rocks, thick white {foam} covered the surface of the sea near the shore.
exz: 巨浪拍打岩石時，厚厚的白色泡沫覆蓋了岸邊的海面。

fix: flee 是「（為躲避危險而）逃離」；「逃避（責任、問題）」較接近 avoid / escape from，意思不完全一樣。
ex: Thousands of people {fled} their homes and ran toward the coast when the volcano suddenly began to erupt.
exz: 火山突然開始爆發時，數千人逃離家園，往海岸奔去。

ex: The magazine got an {exclusive} interview with the movie star, so no other reporter could talk to him that day.
exz: 那本雜誌取得那位電影明星的獨家專訪，當天其他記者都無法跟他談話。

zh: 擁抱；欣然接受（新觀念、改變）
ex: Young people usually {embrace} new technology quickly, while older people may need more time to get used to it.
exz: 年輕人通常很快就接受新科技，而年長者可能需要較多時間適應。

zh: 廣泛的；大規模的；大量的
ex: The strong earthquake caused {extensive} damage to roads and buildings, and it took the city years to rebuild.
exz: 強烈地震對道路和建築造成大範圍的損害，城市花了好幾年才重建。

ex: The teacher {frowned} when she saw that half the class had not done their homework again.
exz: 老師看到班上一半的人又沒寫作業，皺起了眉頭。

ex: The young artist's paintings are now on display at a small {gallery} near the train station.
exz: 這位年輕畫家的作品目前在火車站附近的一間小畫廊展出。

ex: Fans waited outside the hotel for hours, hoping to catch a {glimpse} of the famous singer.
exz: 粉絲在飯店外等了好幾個小時，希望能瞥見那位知名歌手一眼。

ex: Freedom of speech is a {fundamental} right in a democratic country, and it is protected by law.
exz: 言論自由是民主國家的基本權利，受到法律保障。

ex: The main {function} of the heart is to pump blood to every part of the body.
exz: 心臟的主要功能是將血液輸送到身體各部位。

ex: She put the photo of her family in a wooden {frame} and hung it on the living room wall.
exz: 她把全家福照片放進木框，掛在客廳牆上。

ex: Please be careful with that box because it contains {fragile} glass cups that my grandmother gave me.
exz: 請小心那個箱子，因為裡面裝著奶奶送我的易碎玻璃杯。

ex: The little girls {giggled} at the funny faces their father made behind the teacher's back.
exz: 小女孩們看到爸爸在老師背後扮的鬼臉，咯咯地笑了起來。

ex: The bride looked beautiful in her long white {gown} as she walked down the aisle.
exz: 新娘穿著白色長禮服走過紅毯，看起來美極了。

ex: To show her {gratitude}, she wrote a thank-you card to the nurse who had taken care of her.
exz: 為了表達感激，她寫了一張感謝卡給照顧過她的護士。

zh: 感激的；感謝的（be grateful to sb for sth）
fix: grateful 是形容詞「感激的」；名詞「感激」是 gratitude。
ex: I am very {grateful} to my teachers for all their help and encouragement during my senior year.
exz: 我非常感激老師們在我高三這一年的所有幫助與鼓勵。

ex: Scientists say that the {frequency} of heavy rain has increased in recent years because of climate change.
exz: 科學家說，由於氣候變遷，近年來豪雨的頻率增加了。

ex: Thanks to the {generosity} of local businesses, the school was able to buy new computers for every classroom.
exz: 多虧當地企業慷慨解囊，學校得以為每間教室添購新電腦。

ex: Experts checked the painting carefully and confirmed that it was a {genuine} work by Van Gogh, not a copy.
exz: 專家仔細檢驗那幅畫，確認是梵谷的真跡，而非複製品。

fix: grace 是「優雅、風度」；「大方、慷慨」是 generosity，兩字不同。
ex: The ballet dancer moved across the stage with such {grace} that the audience could hardly take their eyes off her.
exz: 芭蕾舞者在舞台上移動得如此優雅，觀眾幾乎無法把目光從她身上移開。

ex: She believed in the {goodness} of people and always helped strangers without expecting anything in return.
exz: 她相信人性本善，總是幫助陌生人而不求回報。

ex: The {gracious} hostess welcomed every guest at the door with a warm smile and a cup of tea.
exz: 親切的女主人在門口以溫暖的笑容和一杯茶迎接每位客人。

ex: I felt {guilty} about eating the last piece of cake, because my sister had been saving it for after dinner.
exz: 我吃了最後一塊蛋糕覺得很愧疚，因為那是姊姊留著晚餐後要吃的。

fix: hasten 是「加速、趕快」（hasten the process / hasten to do），不是「催促」別人（催促是 urge）。
ex: The doctor said that regular exercise and a healthy diet would {hasten} her recovery after the operation.
exz: 醫生說規律運動和健康飲食能加快她術後的康復。

zh: 閒置的；無所事事的；懶散的
ex: Many factories have stayed {idle} since the economy slowed down, and thousands of workers are without jobs.
exz: 自從經濟放緩，許多工廠一直閒置，數千名工人失業。

ex: Eating too much {greasy} food, such as fried chicken and French fries, is bad for your health.
exz: 吃太多炸雞、薯條這類油膩的食物對健康有害。

zh: 停止；暫停（come to a halt）
fix: halt 是名詞／動詞「停止」，不是形容詞「停止行進的」；常用 come to a halt（停下來）。
ex: The train suddenly came to a {halt} because a cow was standing on the tracks in front of it.
exz: 火車突然停了下來，因為前方鐵軌上站著一頭牛。

ex: The twin sisters look {identical}, so even their own teachers often call them by the wrong names in class.
exz: 那對雙胞胎姊妹長得一模一樣，連老師上課都常叫錯她們的名字。

ex: The plants could not survive the {harsh} winter in the mountains, where temperatures often dropped below zero.
exz: 這些植物熬不過山上嚴酷的冬天，那裡氣溫常降到零度以下。

ex: In his {haste} to catch the bus, he left his phone and wallet on the kitchen table.
exz: 他急著趕公車，把手機和錢包忘在廚房餐桌上。

ex: Every morning, my father {grinds} fresh coffee beans by hand before making a cup of coffee for my mother.
exz: 每天早上，我爸都先手工磨新鮮咖啡豆，再為我媽泡一杯咖啡。

zh: 海灣（比 bay 大）；（意見）鴻溝
ex: The warm water of the {gulf} attracts many tourists who come to swim, sail, and watch dolphins every summer.
exz: 每年夏天，這片海灣溫暖的海水吸引許多遊客前來游泳、駕帆船和賞海豚。

ex: After her old dog died, the little girl was filled with {grief} and cried in her room for several days.
exz: 老狗死後，小女孩悲痛萬分，在房間裡哭了好幾天。

ex: This washing machine comes with a two-year {guarantee}, so the company will repair it for free if it breaks.
exz: 這台洗衣機附兩年保固，如果壞了公司會免費修理。

ex: The long war left deep {hatred} between the two countries, and it lasted for many generations after the fighting ended.
exz: 那場漫長的戰爭在兩國間留下深仇大恨，戰事結束後仍延續了好幾代。

fix: guilt 主要指「罪惡感、內疚」或「有罪（的事實）」；「罪（行）」較接近 crime 或宗教上的 sin。
ex: He was full of {guilt} after shouting at his little sister, so he bought her ice cream to say sorry.
exz: 他對妹妹大吼後滿心愧疚，所以買冰淇淋向她道歉。

zh: 墳墓（adj. 嚴重的；嚴肅的）
ex: Every year during the Tomb Sweeping Festival, we visit my grandfather's {grave} and clean it carefully.
exz: 每年清明節，我們都會去祖父的墳前仔細打掃。

ex: This bag is only a cheap {imitation} of a famous brand, so it broke after just one month.
exz: 這個包只是名牌的廉價仿冒品，所以才一個月就壞了。

ex: I {intend} to study abroad after graduating from college, so I have been saving money and practicing English every day.
exz: 我打算大學畢業後出國留學，所以每天都在存錢、練英文。

zh: 智力的；理智的（n. 知識分子）
fix: intellectual 是形容詞「智力的、知性的」或名詞「知識分子」；名詞「智力」是 intellect / intelligence。
ex: Experts say that reading and solving puzzles are good for the {intellectual} development of young children.
exz: 專家說，閱讀和解謎有益於幼兒的智力發展。

ex: Because of high {inflation}, the prices of food and rent have gone up much faster than people's salaries.
exz: 由於通膨嚴重，食物和房租價格上漲的速度遠比薪水快。

ex: The technician came to {install} a new air conditioner in my bedroom before the hot summer started.
exz: 技師在炎熱夏天來臨前，來我房間安裝新冷氣。

ex: Wearing clean clothes and arriving on time will help you make a good {impression} at a job interview.
exz: 穿著整潔、準時抵達，有助你在工作面試時留下好印象。

ex: The pilot {instructed} the passengers to fasten their seat belts because the plane was about to land.
exz: 機長指示乘客繫好安全帶，因為飛機即將降落。

ex: Many {immigrants} from Vietnam and Indonesia have settled in Taiwan, and their children speak both languages fluently.
exz: 許多來自越南和印尼的移民已在台灣定居，他們的孩子兩種語言都說得很流利。

ex: Her family decided to {immigrate} to Canada when she was ten, hoping for a better life there.
exz: 她十歲時，全家決定移民到加拿大，希望在那裡過更好的生活。

zh: 無知的；不知道的（be ignorant of）
ex: Many people are {ignorant} of the dangers of using their phones while crossing the street.
exz: 許多人不知道邊過馬路邊滑手機的危險。

fix: instinct 是「本能、直覺」（天生的反應）；「本性」較接近 nature。
ex: Young birds know how to build nests by {instinct}, because nobody ever teaches them how to do it.
exz: 幼鳥憑本能就知道怎麼築巢，因為從來沒有誰教過牠們。

zh: 強加；課（稅）；實施（impose A on B）
ex: The government decided to {impose} a heavy tax on cigarettes in order to reduce smoking.
exz: 政府決定對香菸課重稅，以減少吸菸人口。

ex: My {initial} plan was to study medicine, but I later changed my mind and chose engineering.
exz: 我最初的計畫是讀醫學，但後來改變心意，選了工程。

ex: {Initially}, I didn't like living in the dorm, but after a few weeks I made many good friends there.
exz: 起初我不喜歡住宿舍，但幾週後我在那裡交到許多好朋友。

ex: Before the trip, we had to {inflate} the rubber boat with a pump, which took almost an hour.
exz: 出發前，我們得用打氣筒幫橡皮艇充氣，花了將近一小時。

ex: A good referee must be {impartial} and should not favor either team, even if his own son is playing.
exz: 好裁判必須公正，不能偏袒任何一隊，即使自己的兒子在場上也一樣。

ex: The nurse gently held the newborn {infant} and placed her in her mother's arms for the first time.
exz: 護士輕輕抱起剛出生的嬰兒，第一次把她放進媽媽懷裡。

fix: indication 是名詞「跡象、表示」；「指出」是動詞 indicate。
ex: There is no {indication} that the rain will stop soon, so we had better cancel the picnic.
exz: 沒有任何跡象顯示雨會很快停，所以我們最好取消野餐。

ex: He {insulted} the waiter by calling him stupid in front of everyone, so the manager asked him to leave.
exz: 他當眾罵服務生笨，侮辱了對方，所以經理請他離開。

ex: To start the machine, please {insert} a coin into the slot and press the green button.
exz: 要啟動機器，請把硬幣投入投幣孔，再按下綠色按鈕。

ex: Before the flight, the mechanic carefully {inspected} the engine to make sure everything was working properly.
exz: 起飛前，技師仔細檢查引擎，確保一切運作正常。

ex: When she said, "It's getting late," she was {implying} that she wanted the guests to go home.
exz: 她說「時間不早了」，是在暗示希望客人回家。

ex: On an {impulse}, he bought an expensive guitar, even though he did not know how to play it.
exz: 他一時衝動買了一把昂貴的吉他，雖然他根本不會彈。

ex: The teacher asked us to {interpret} the poem in our own words and explain what the poet was trying to say.
exz: 老師要我們用自己的話詮釋這首詩，並說明詩人想表達什麼。

ex: Professor Lin gave a {lecture} on climate change, and more than three hundred students came to listen.
exz: 林教授發表一場關於氣候變遷的演講，超過三百名學生前來聆聽。

ex: The {lecturer} spoke so clearly and humorously that nobody in the hall fell asleep during the two-hour talk.
exz: 講者說得清楚又幽默，兩小時的演講中，大廳裡沒有人睡著。

zh: 密集的；加強的；（醫）加護的
fix: intensive 主要是「密集的、加強的」（intensive course 密集課程）；「徹底的」較接近 thorough。
ex: Before moving to Japan, she took an {intensive} Japanese course that met for four hours every day.
exz: 搬去日本前，她上了一個每天上課四小時的日語密集班。

zh: 猛拉；猛推；猛然一動（n.（俚）混蛋）
ex: When the driver stepped on the gas, the bus {jerked} forward suddenly, and several standing passengers almost fell to the floor.
exz: 司機一踩油門，公車突然猛地往前一衝，好幾位站著的乘客差點跌倒。

ex: My parents rarely {interfere} in my choice of friends, but they do ask me to be home before ten.
exz: 我爸媽很少干涉我交什麼朋友，但會要求我十點前回家。

ex: Her {intuition} told her that something was wrong, so she called her son and found out he was sick.
exz: 她的直覺告訴她出事了，於是打電話給兒子，才知道他生病了。

zh: 意圖；打算（have no intention of V-ing）
ex: I have no {intention} of quitting the team, even though we keep losing games this season.
exz: 雖然我們這一季一直輸球，我完全沒有退出球隊的打算。

ex: Doctors decided to {isolate} the sick patient so that the virus would not spread to others.
exz: 醫生決定隔離那位病人，以免病毒傳染給其他人。

zh: 偏遠的；隔絕的；孤立的、孤單的
ex: The mountain village is so {isolated} that the nearest supermarket is a two-hour drive along a narrow road.
exz: 那座山村非常偏僻，最近的超市要沿著窄路開車兩小時。

ex: This class is for {intermediate} learners who already know basic grammar and want to improve their speaking.
exz: 這堂課適合已經學會基礎文法、想加強口說的中級學習者。

fix: intensity 是名詞「強度、強烈程度」；「強烈的」是形容詞 intense。
ex: The {intensity} of the typhoon increased as it moved closer to the east coast of Taiwan.
exz: 颱風逼近台灣東岸時，強度增強了。

ex: The {invasion} of the country by foreign troops forced millions of people to leave their homes.
exz: 外國軍隊入侵該國，迫使數百萬人離開家園。

ex: My uncle {invested} most of his savings in a small coffee shop, which is now very successful.
exz: 叔叔把大部分積蓄投資在一間小咖啡店，如今經營得很成功。

zh: 涉及；包含；使參與（be involved in）
ex: The job {involves} a lot of traveling, so you will spend about two weeks a month abroad.
exz: 這份工作需要經常出差，所以你每個月大約有兩週在國外。

ex: She filled the {kettle} with water and put it on the stove to make tea for her guests.
exz: 她把水壺裝滿水，放在爐子上為客人泡茶。

ex: Nobody believes him anymore because he is a well-known {liar} who often makes up stories.
exz: 再也沒人相信他，因為大家都知道他是個愛編故事的騙子。

zh: 使用手冊（adj. 手的；手動的）
ex: If you don't know how to use the new camera, read the {manual} that came with it.
exz: 如果你不會用新相機，就讀隨附的使用手冊。

ex: The teacher wrote helpful comments in red ink in the {margin} of my essay, next to each mistake.
exz: 老師用紅筆在我作文的頁邊空白、每個錯誤旁寫下有用的評語。

ex: After eating a huge dinner at the restaurant, my father {loosened} his belt and lay down on the sofa.
exz: 在餐廳吃完一頓大餐後，爸爸鬆開皮帶，躺在沙發上。

ex: She took out a bank {loan} to pay for her college education and spent ten years paying it back.
exz: 她向銀行貸款支付大學學費，花了十年才還清。

zh: 磨坊；工廠（如 paper mill 造紙廠）
ex: In the past, farmers brought their wheat to the {mill}, where it was ground into flour.
exz: 過去農夫把小麥送到磨坊，在那裡磨成麵粉。

ex: The twins are always getting into {mischief}, like hiding their teacher's glasses or drawing on the walls.
exz: 那對雙胞胎老是在搗蛋，像是藏老師的眼鏡或在牆上畫畫。

ex: Their friendship is based on {mutual} respect, so they never laugh at each other's dreams.
exz: 他們的友誼建立在互相尊重上，所以從不嘲笑彼此的夢想。

zh: 溫和的；輕微的；（味道）淡的
ex: The winter in southern Taiwan is usually {mild}, so people there rarely need to wear heavy coats or gloves.
exz: 南台灣的冬天通常很溫和，所以當地人很少需要穿厚外套或戴手套。

ex: The education {ministry} announced that all schools would close for two days because of the strong typhoon.
exz: 教育部宣布，因強颱來襲，所有學校停課兩天。

ex: The weather was cold and rainy that morning; {nevertheless}, thousands of runners showed up for the city marathon.
exz: 那天早上又冷又下雨；儘管如此，仍有數千名跑者參加城市馬拉松。

ex: Only two students in our class got full marks on the math test, {namely} Amy and Kevin.
exz: 我們班只有兩位同學數學考滿分，也就是艾美和凱文。

zh: 適度的；中等的；溫和的（v. 緩和）
ex: Doctors suggest doing at least thirty minutes of {moderate} exercise, such as fast walking, five days a week.
exz: 醫生建議每週五天、每天至少做三十分鐘中等強度的運動，例如快走。

ex: He was so busy playing online games that he {neglected} his studies and failed three subjects.
exz: 他忙著打線上遊戲，荒廢了課業，結果三科不及格。

ex: Helping the poor without asking for anything in return is a {noble} act that everyone should respect.
exz: 幫助窮人而不求回報，是人人都應尊敬的崇高行為。

ex: In the United States, the {federal} government is in charge of things like the army and foreign affairs.
exz: 在美國，聯邦政府負責軍隊和外交等事務。

ex: Several sports clubs joined together to form a national {federation} that organizes competitions every year.
exz: 幾個運動俱樂部聯合起來，組成一個每年舉辦比賽的全國總會。

zh: 連續劇；連載（adj. 連續的；一系列的）
ex: My grandmother never misses an episode of the TV {serial} that is shown every evening at eight.
exz: 奶奶從不錯過每晚八點播出的那部電視連續劇的任何一集。

ex: She took care of sick and poor people for fifty years, so many people called her a living {saint}.
exz: 她照顧病人與窮人長達五十年，許多人稱她為在世聖人。

ex: The mayor was arrested for {corruption} after he took money from a company in exchange for a building contract.
exz: 市長因收受某公司金錢換取工程合約，以貪污罪被捕。

ex: Apple is one of the largest {corporations} in the world, with stores in dozens of countries.
exz: 蘋果是全世界最大的企業之一，在數十個國家都有門市。

ex: The government offers low-interest loans to help small {enterprises} grow and create more jobs in rural areas.
exz: 政府提供低利貸款，幫助小型企業成長，並在鄉村地區創造更多工作機會。

ex: Thanks to the {cooperation} of all the neighbors, the street was cleaned up in just one afternoon.
exz: 多虧所有鄰居同心合作，這條街只花一個下午就打掃乾淨了。

ex: The salesperson earns a ten percent {commission} on every car she sells, so she works very hard.
exz: 那位業務員每賣出一輛車可抽一成佣金，所以她工作非常賣力。

zh: 推薦；建議（recommend V-ing / that S (should) V）
ex: Can you {recommend} a good restaurant near the station? We want to try some local food.
exz: 你可以推薦車站附近一家好餐廳嗎？我們想嚐嚐當地美食。

ex: I asked my homeroom teacher to write a letter of {recommendation} for my college application, and she happily agreed.
exz: 我請班導幫我的大學申請寫一封推薦信，她很爽快地答應了。

ex: The hotel was clean, cheap, and close to the beach, so it is highly {recommendable} for families with kids.
exz: 那家飯店乾淨、便宜又靠近海灘，非常值得推薦給有小孩的家庭。

fix: recommendatory 是形容詞「建議性的、推薦的」，中文要寫成形容詞，不是名詞「建議」；此字很少用，常見說法是 advisory。
ex: The new rules are only {recommendatory}, so companies can decide for themselves whether to follow them.
exz: 這些新規定只是建議性質，所以公司可以自行決定是否遵守。

zh: 給予；准許；承認（n. 補助金）
ex: Because of her excellent grades and volunteer work, the university {granted} her a full scholarship for four years.
exz: 由於她成績優異又熱心服務，大學授予她四年全額獎學金。

ex: Different readers may have different {interpretations} of the same poem, and none of them is completely wrong.
exz: 不同讀者對同一首詩可能有不同的詮釋，而且沒有哪一種完全錯誤。

ex: North Korea is ruled by a {communist} party that controls almost every part of people's lives.
exz: 北韓由一個幾乎掌控人民生活各層面的共產黨統治。

ex: As the typhoon came closer, pressure {mounted} on the mayor to cancel school and work.
exz: 隨著颱風逼近，要求市長宣布停班停課的壓力不斷升高。

ex: Instead of running away from her problems, she decided to {confront} them one by one.
exz: 她決定不再逃避問題，而是一一面對。

ex: Only authorized medical {personnel} are allowed to enter the laboratory, so all visitors must wait outside the door.
exz: 只有獲授權的醫療人員可以進入實驗室，所以所有訪客都必須在門外等候。

ex: Young children may not understand the {distinction} between right and wrong, so parents must teach them.
exz: 幼童可能還不懂是非的區別，所以父母必須教導他們。

zh: 給予…權利（be entitled to）；為…命名
ex: This ticket {entitles} you to a free drink and a discount on any meal in the restaurant.
exz: 這張票讓你享有一杯免費飲料以及餐廳任何餐點的折扣。

ex: In some countries, {abortion} is still against the law, and women must travel abroad to end a pregnancy.
exz: 在某些國家墮胎仍是違法的，女性必須出國才能終止懷孕。

my: adj|惡劣的、骯髒的 / v,n|犯規
ex: A {foul} smell came from the garbage can, which nobody had emptied for over a week.
exz: 垃圾桶傳出一股惡臭，已經超過一週沒人倒了。

ex: Our math teacher will not {tolerate} cheating, and anyone caught copying answers will get a zero on the test.
exz: 我們數學老師絕不容許作弊，被抓到抄答案的人考試會得零分。

ex: Many people believe the country should {abolish} the death penalty because innocent people might be killed.
exz: 許多人認為國家應該廢除死刑，因為無辜的人可能會被處死。

ex: The sports reporter gave a lively {commentary} on the baseball game, describing every hit and catch.
exz: 體育記者為棒球比賽做了生動的實況解說，描述每一次安打與接殺。

zh: 外交的；圓滑的、有手腕的
ex: After the border conflict, the two countries cut off {diplomatic} relations and closed their embassies in each other's capitals.
exz: 邊境衝突後，兩國斷絕外交關係，並關閉在對方首都的大使館。

zh: 察覺；感知；把…視為（perceive A as B）
ex: Many teenagers {perceive} their parents' advice as criticism, even when it is meant to help them.
exz: 許多青少年把父母的建議視為批評，即使那是出於好意。

ex: Social media can change our {perception} of beauty, making many young people unhappy with their looks.
exz: 社群媒體可能改變我們對美的看法，讓許多年輕人不滿意自己的外表。

ex: In the dark forest, it was hard to {discern} the path, so we turned on our flashlights.
exz: 在黑暗的森林裡很難看清路徑，所以我們打開了手電筒。

ex: After winning the election, the new president {proclaimed} that a new era had begun for the country.
exz: 贏得選舉後，新總統宣告國家進入一個新時代。

zh: 大量的；可觀的；堅固的、實質的
my: 大量的、堅固的 / 大量的
ex: She received a {substantial} pay raise after only one year, so she could finally afford her own car.
exz: 她才一年就獲得大幅加薪，終於買得起自己的車。

ex: The {prospect} of studying abroad in London next year makes her feel both excited and a little nervous.
exz: 明年要去倫敦留學的前景，讓她既興奮又有點緊張。

my: 證明合理、說明理由、使之正當化
ex: Nothing can {justify} hitting a child, no matter how badly he or she has behaved at school or at home.
exz: 無論孩子在學校或家裡表現多糟，都沒有任何理由能合理化打小孩。

ex: There is no {justification} for cheating on an exam, even if you are under a lot of pressure.
exz: 考試作弊沒有正當理由，即使你壓力再大也一樣。

zh: 當代的；同時代的（n. 同時代的人）
ex: The museum has a large collection of {contemporary} art, including works by young Taiwanese artists.
exz: 這間美術館收藏大量當代藝術，包括台灣年輕藝術家的作品。

ex: Many people still hold the {notion} that boys are better at math than girls, but research shows this is not true.
exz: 許多人仍抱持男生數學比女生好的觀念，但研究顯示並非如此。

ex: The tailor {altered} the old wedding dress so that it would fit the bride perfectly on her big day.
exz: 裁縫修改了那件舊婚紗，讓新娘在大喜之日穿得完全合身。

ex: We made a few {alterations} to the plan after the weather report said it would rain on Saturday.
exz: 氣象報告說週六會下雨後，我們對計畫做了一些修改。

ex: The soldiers {executed} the plan perfectly, and the hostages were rescued without anyone getting hurt.
exz: 士兵完美執行了計畫，人質獲救，沒有任何人受傷。

ex: The idea sounds great, but its {execution} will require a lot of money and careful planning.
exz: 這個點子聽起來很棒，但執行起來需要大量資金和周詳的規劃。

ex: All students must {submit} their science reports online by Friday at midnight, or they will lose ten points.
exz: 所有學生必須在週五午夜前上網繳交自然科報告，否則扣十分。

fix: submission 雖有「屈服、順從」之意（接近投降），但學測更常考「提交、繳交」；「投降」本身是 surrender。
ex: The deadline for the {submission} of applications is March 1, so please send yours as soon as possible.
exz: 申請的繳交截止日是三月一日，所以請盡快寄出你的申請。

zh: 計畫；方案；詭計（v. 密謀）
ex: The government started a new {scheme} to help young people buy their first homes at lower prices.
exz: 政府推出一項新方案，幫助年輕人以較低價格買下第一間房子。

zh: 情節；陰謀；小塊土地（v. 密謀；策劃）
ex: The movie has a simple {plot}, but the beautiful music and acting make it worth watching.
exz: 這部電影情節簡單，但優美的配樂和演技讓它值得一看。

zh: 部分的；偏袒的（be partial to 偏愛）
ex: The storm caused only {partial} damage to the bridge, so it reopened to traffic after a week.
exz: 暴風雨只對橋造成局部損壞，所以一週後就恢復通車。

ex: A large {proportion} of the students in this school come from families that speak two languages at home.
exz: 這所學校有很大比例的學生來自在家說兩種語言的家庭。

ex: In this small rural school, the {ratio} of students to teachers is only about ten to one.
exz: 在這所鄉下小學校，學生與老師的比例只有大約十比一。

zh: 產出；出產；屈服、讓步（n. 產量）
ex: Thanks to the good weather, the rice fields {yielded} a much larger harvest than last year.
exz: 多虧好天氣，稻田的收成比去年多得多。

ex: The bridge was badly damaged in the earthquake; {hence}, all cars must take a different route into town.
exz: 橋在地震中嚴重受損，因此所有車輛必須改道進城。

ex: After a long trial, justice finally {prevailed}, and the innocent man was released from prison and went home.
exz: 經過漫長審判，正義終於獲勝，無辜的男子獲釋出獄回家。

zh: 盛行的；普遍的；佔優勢的
fix: prevailing 是形容詞「盛行的、普遍的」，中文要加「的」；動詞「盛行」是 prevail。
ex: The {prevailing} wind in this area blows from the northeast in winter, so most houses face south.
exz: 這一帶冬天的盛行風來自東北方，所以大部分房子都朝南。

ex: Nothing can grow on this {barren} land because it gets almost no rain all year.
exz: 這片貧瘠的土地一年到頭幾乎不下雨，什麼都長不出來。

zh: 精密的；複雜的；世故的、有見識的
ex: Modern cars are controlled by {sophisticated} computer systems that can even park the car by themselves.
exz: 現代汽車由精密的電腦系統控制，甚至可以自動停車。

zh: 歸因於（attribute A to B）（n. 特質）
ex: The famous scientist {attributes} her success to hard work, good luck, and the support of her family.
exz: 這位知名科學家把成功歸功於努力、好運和家人的支持。

zh: 運輸；交通（public transit 大眾運輸）；運送中
ex: Taipei has an excellent public {transit} system, so many people there don't need to own a car.
exz: 台北有很棒的大眾運輸系統，所以當地許多人不需要買車。

zh: 史無前例的；前所未有的
ex: The pandemic caused an {unprecedented} situation in which almost every school in the world closed at the same time.
exz: 疫情造成前所未有的情況，全世界幾乎每所學校同時停課。

ex: Climbing Mount Everest requires {immense} courage and physical strength, and many climbers train for years before trying.
exz: 攀登聖母峰需要極大的勇氣和體力，許多登山者會先訓練好幾年才嘗試。

ex: The teacher gave me a one-week {extension} on my report because I had been sick in the hospital.
exz: 因為我生病住院，老師讓我的報告延後一週繳交。

ex: The book gives a {comprehensive} introduction to Taiwanese history, from ancient times to the present day.
exz: 這本書全面介紹台灣歷史，從古代一路到現今。

ex: Tonight's big game is Taiwan {versus} Japan, and millions of fans will be watching it on TV.
exz: 今晚的大賽是台灣對日本，數百萬球迷會在電視前觀看。

zh: 壓力；負擔；拉傷（v. 拉緊；拉傷；使緊張）
ex: Working two jobs and taking care of three kids put a great {strain} on her health.
exz: 身兼兩份工作又要照顧三個孩子，對她的健康造成很大負擔。

ex: My doctor sent me to a heart {specialist} because he heard something unusual when he listened to my chest.
exz: 醫生聽診時聽到異常的聲音，所以轉介我去看心臟專科醫師。

zh: （中斷後）重新開始；繼續（n. résumé 履歷）
fix: resume 當動詞主要是「（中斷後）重新開始、繼續」，「重返」只用在 resume one's seat 這類說法；名詞「履歷」通常寫作 résumé，發音不同。
ex: After a short break for lunch, the meeting {resumed} at one o'clock and lasted until five.
exz: 午餐短暫休息後，會議在一點重新開始，一直開到五點。

ex: We visited the {observatory} on the mountain at night and looked at Saturn through a huge telescope.
exz: 我們晚上參觀山上的天文台，透過巨大的望遠鏡看土星。

ex: If you want to find a topic quickly, look it up in the {index} at the back of the book.
exz: 如果想快速找到某個主題，就查書末的索引。

zh: 沒有安全感的；不安全的；不穩固的
ex: Many teenagers feel {insecure} about their looks and compare themselves to people on social media.
exz: 許多青少年對自己的外表沒有安全感，常拿自己和社群媒體上的人比較。

ex: The airline gave each passenger a free hotel room to {compensate} for the twelve-hour delay.
exz: 航空公司給每位乘客一間免費飯店房間，以補償延誤十二小時。

zh: 流行病；疫情（的爆發）（複數）
ex: In the past, terrible {epidemics} of diseases like cholera and plague killed thousands of people in crowded cities.
exz: 過去霍亂、鼠疫等疾病的大流行，在擁擠的城市奪走數千條人命。

ex: The {essence} of good teaching is not giving answers but helping students think for themselves.
exz: 好教學的本質不在於給答案，而是幫助學生獨立思考。

zh: 維持；支撐；遭受（傷害、損失）
ex: The driver {sustained} serious injuries in the car crash and had to stay in the hospital for a month.
exz: 駕駛在車禍中受了重傷，必須住院一個月。

ex: The young violinist showed {extraordinary} talent, playing difficult pieces perfectly at the age of eight.
exz: 那位年輕的小提琴家展現非凡天分，八歲就能完美演奏困難的曲子。

ex: Only students with {exceptional} grades can get this scholarship, so the competition is very strong.
exz: 只有成績特別優異的學生能拿到這份獎學金，所以競爭非常激烈。

zh: 非凡的；值得注意的；驚人的
ex: The patient made a {remarkable} recovery and was able to walk again just two weeks after the surgery.
exz: 病人恢復得驚人，手術後才兩週就能再次走路。

ex: He looks like an {ordinary} man, but he is actually a famous writer who has sold millions of books.
exz: 他看起來像個普通人，但其實是賣出數百萬本書的知名作家。

ex: The school {suspended} the student for a week after he was caught fighting in the hallway.
exz: 那名學生在走廊打架被抓到後，學校讓他停學一週。

zh: 暫停；停學；懸掛；（車）懸吊系統
ex: Because of the strong typhoon, there was a two-day {suspension} of all flights to the outer islands.
exz: 由於強颱來襲，飛往離島的所有航班暫停兩天。

ex: Public {sentiment} turned against the plan after people learned it would destroy part of the forest.
exz: 民眾得知這項計畫會破壞部分森林後，輿論轉而反對。

zh: 情感上的；多愁善感的；感情用事的
ex: This old watch is not worth much money, but it has great {sentimental} value because it was my grandfather's.
exz: 這支舊錶不值多少錢，但很有紀念價值，因為它是我爺爺的。

zh: 門廊（房屋入口有屋頂的地方）
fix: porch 是房屋入口有屋頂的「門廊」；「陽台」是 balcony，兩者不同。
ex: In the summer evenings, my grandparents like to sit on the front {porch} and watch the neighbors walk by.
exz: 夏天傍晚，爺爺奶奶喜歡坐在前門廊看鄰居走過。

ex: Drivers who {exceed} the speed limit will be fined, and their licenses may even be taken away.
exz: 超速的駕駛會被罰款，駕照甚至可能被吊扣。

ex: {Excessive} use of smartphones can harm your eyes and make it hard for you to fall asleep at night.
exz: 過度使用智慧型手機會傷害眼睛，也會讓你晚上難以入睡。

ex: Her performance was {flawless}; she did not make a single mistake during the whole piano competition.
exz: 她的表現完美無瑕，整場鋼琴比賽沒有犯任何一個錯。

ex: She added two {lumps} of sugar to her tea and stirred it slowly with a small spoon.
exz: 她在茶裡加了兩塊方糖，用小湯匙慢慢攪拌。

ex: As soon as the traffic light turned green, the red sports car {accelerated} quickly and disappeared down the road.
exz: 紅綠燈一轉綠，那輛紅色跑車就迅速加速，消失在路的盡頭。

ex: The night market sells many {exotic} fruits from Southeast Asia, such as durian and mangosteen, that tourists love to try.
exz: 夜市販售許多來自東南亞的異國水果，例如榴槤和山竹，觀光客都愛嚐鮮。

zh: 機構；學院；研究所（v. 制定；開始實施）
my: n|機構、學院 / v|開始、制定
ex: She works at a research {institute} that studies earthquakes and tries to predict when they will happen.
exz: 她在一間研究地震、試圖預測地震何時發生的研究機構工作。

zh: 源自；得到（derive from；derive A from B）
ex: Many English words {derive} from Latin, so learning Latin roots can help you guess their meanings.
exz: 許多英文單字源自拉丁文，所以學拉丁字根能幫你猜字義。

zh: 全體教職員；（大學）院系；能力
ex: The new principal held a meeting with all the {faculty} members to discuss the school's plans for next year.
exz: 新校長和全體教職員開會，討論學校明年的計畫。

ex: Since nobody answered the door and the lights were off, I {presumed} that the family was away on vacation.
exz: 因為沒人應門、燈也關著，我推測那家人出外度假了。

ex: The police acted on the {presumption} that the missing girl was still alive, so they kept searching.
exz: 警方以失蹤女孩仍活著為前提行動，所以持續搜尋。

ex: The lights in his office are still on, so he is {presumably} working late again tonight.
exz: 他辦公室的燈還亮著，所以他今晚大概又在加班。

zh: 邊境；新領域；（研究的）尖端
ex: Space is often called the last {frontier}, because there is still so much we do not know about it.
exz: 太空常被稱為人類最後的未開發領域，因為我們對它仍有太多未知。

ex: There is a coffee {stain} on my white shirt, and it will not come out no matter how hard I wash it.
exz: 我的白襯衫上有一塊咖啡漬，怎麼洗都洗不掉。

ex: The doctor took a blood {specimen} from the patient and sent it to the lab for testing.
exz: 醫生從病人身上採了血液樣本，送到實驗室檢驗。

ex: The {zealous} volunteers worked through the night to pack food boxes and blankets for the flood victims.
exz: 熱心的志工們徹夜為水災災民打包食物箱和毛毯。

ex: World leaders strongly {condemned} the bombing of the children's hospital, calling it a terrible crime against humanity.
exz: 各國領袖強烈譴責兒童醫院遭轟炸，稱之為可怕的反人道罪行。

zh: 爭奪；搶奪；攀爬；（scrambled eggs）炒蛋
ex: When the doors opened, shoppers {scrambled} for the cheap TVs, pushing each other out of the way.
exz: 門一開，購物者就爭搶便宜的電視，互相推擠。

ex: My aunt always {meddles} in my love life, asking when I will get married and introducing me to strangers.
exz: 我阿姨總愛干涉我的感情生活，一直問我何時結婚，還幫我介紹陌生人。

zh: 婉拒；下降、衰退（n. 下降）
my: 衰退；下降；拒絕 / 婉拒、衰退
ex: She politely {declined} the job offer because the company was too far from her home and the salary was low.
exz: 她婉拒了那份工作，因為公司離家太遠，薪水又低。

ex: It was hard for people a hundred years ago to {conceive} of a world where everyone carries a phone.
exz: 一百年前的人很難想像一個人人都帶著手機的世界。

zh: 多變的；可變的（n. 變數、變因）
ex: The weather in the mountains is highly {variable}, so hikers should bring both sunscreen and a raincoat.
exz: 山上的天氣變化很大，所以登山客應同時帶防曬乳和雨衣。

my: 罪犯 / n|罪犯 / v|定罪
ex: After a three-month trial, the jury {convicted} him of murder, and he was sentenced to life in prison.
exz: 經過三個月的審判，陪審團判他謀殺罪成立，他被判終身監禁。

ex: On cold winter nights, my mother makes a beef {stew} with potatoes and carrots that warms the whole family.
exz: 寒冷的冬夜，媽媽會燉一鍋加了馬鈴薯和紅蘿蔔的牛肉，讓全家暖呼呼的。

zh: 贊助者；贊助商（v. 贊助）
ex: A big sports company is the main {sponsor} of the marathon, providing free shoes and water for all runners.
exz: 一家大型運動品牌是這場馬拉松的主要贊助商，為所有跑者提供免費鞋子和水。

ex: After listening to both sides for three days, the {jury} decided that the woman was not guilty of stealing.
exz: 聽了雙方三天的陳述後，陪審團判定那名女子沒有犯竊盜罪。

ex: The {prosecutor} showed the court a video that proved the man had been at the scene of the crime.
exz: 檢察官向法庭出示一段影片，證明那名男子曾在犯罪現場。

ex: Fresh fruits and vegetables are rich in {fiber}, which keeps our digestive system healthy and makes us feel full longer.
exz: 新鮮蔬果富含纖維，能維持消化系統健康，也讓人更有飽足感。

ex: The BBC sent a {correspondent} to Ukraine to report on the war from the front lines.
exz: BBC 派了一位特派記者到烏克蘭前線報導戰況。

zh: 集會；（網球）來回對打（v. 召集；團結）
ex: Thousands of people joined the {rally} in front of the city hall to protest against the new tax.
exz: 數千人參加在市政府前的集會，抗議新的稅制。

ex: The couple promised each other {eternal} love on their wedding day, in front of all their friends and family.
exz: 新婚當天，這對夫妻在所有親友面前許下永恆之愛的誓言。

zh: 必定的（be bound to V）；受約束的；開往…的
ex: If you keep driving so fast in the rain, you are {bound} to have an accident sooner or later.
exz: 如果你下雨天還一直開這麼快，遲早一定會出車禍。

zh: 噁心的；總的（gross income 總收入）；嚴重的
ex: The bathroom in the old train station was so dirty and smelly that it was really {gross}.
exz: 老車站的廁所又髒又臭，真的很噁心。

ex: It took the new students a few months to {integrate} into the school and make new friends.
exz: 新生花了幾個月才融入學校、交到新朋友。

zh: 間隔；間歇；（戲劇）中場休息
ex: Buses to the airport leave at thirty-minute {intervals}, so you never have to wait very long.
exz: 往機場的巴士每三十分鐘一班，所以你永遠不用等太久。

ex: The man {asserted} that he was innocent, but the video clearly showed him stealing the bike.
exz: 那名男子堅稱自己清白，但影片清楚拍到他偷腳踏車。

ex: The city decided to {undertake} the huge project of building a subway line under the river.
exz: 市政府決定著手進行在河底興建地鐵線的大工程。

zh: 交替的；輪流的（v. 交替、輪流）
ex: My parents take turns cooking dinner on {alternate} days, so my father cooks on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
exz: 我爸媽隔天輪流煮晚餐，所以我爸負責週一、週三和週五。

ex: Learning a new language adds a new {dimension} to your life, opening doors to new friends and cultures.
exz: 學一種新語言為你的生活增添新的面向，開啟結識新朋友、接觸新文化的大門。

zh: 使成為；使變得（render + O + adj.）；提供
ex: The heavy snow {rendered} the mountain road unusable, so the village was cut off for three days.
exz: 大雪使山路無法通行，村子因此與外界隔絕了三天。

ex: Tourism is the main source of {revenue} for the island, so the typhoon season hurts its economy badly.
exz: 觀光是這座島的主要收入來源，所以颱風季對當地經濟傷害很大。

ex: Most {transactions} in this store are now made by phone or card, so cashiers rarely handle cash.
exz: 這家店現在大部分交易都用手機或卡片付款，收銀員很少碰現金。

ex: Everyone trusts our principal because she is a woman of great {integrity} who always keeps her promises.
exz: 大家都信任我們校長，因為她為人非常正直、總是信守承諾。

zh: 否認；拒絕；（心理）不願接受
ex: Despite the clear evidence, the company continued its {denial} that its factory had polluted the river.
exz: 儘管證據確鑿，那家公司仍持續否認其工廠污染了河川。

zh: 強迫；迫使（compel sb to V）
ex: The heavy rain {compelled} us to cancel the picnic and stay at home playing board games.
exz: 大雨迫使我們取消野餐，待在家玩桌遊。

ex: The {freight} train carried coal and steel from the mines to the port every night.
exz: 這列貨運火車每晚把煤和鋼從礦場運到港口。

ex: If you want extra cheese on your pizza, there is an {additional} charge of thirty dollars.
exz: 如果你的披薩要多加起司，需額外收費三十元。

ex: The American {ambassador} met with the president to talk about trade between the two countries.
exz: 美國大使與總統會面，討論兩國之間的貿易。

fix: apparently 是副詞，中文要寫成「顯然地／看來」；「顯然的」是形容詞 apparent。而且它常表示「據說、看起來」，不一定是「很明顯」。

zh: 有能力的；能幹的（be capable of）

exz: 在夏日高溫下把重箱子搬上五樓後，他擦去額頭上的汗。

ex: When a dog suddenly ran onto the road, the driver stepped hard on the {brake} and stopped just in time.

exz: 她穿著白色絲質襯衫和黑裙，去銀行參加第一次工作面試。

zh: 寒冷的；冷颼颼的；冷淡的

zh: 扔；投擲；投下（cast, cast）（n. 演員陣容；石膏）

exz: 漁夫把網撒進海裡，再慢慢拉回滿滿一網魚。

ex: She is taking a {ceramics} class on weekends and has already made several bowls and cups.
exz: 她週末去上陶藝課，已經做了好幾個碗和杯子。

ex: Please {chop} the onions and carrots into small pieces before you put them into the boiling soup.
exz: 請先把洋蔥和紅蘿蔔切成小塊，再放進滾燙的湯裡。

ex: The prince and princess rode through the city in a golden {carriage} pulled by six white horses.
exz: 王子和公主乘坐由六匹白馬拉的金色馬車穿越城市。

zh: 寒意；冷顫（v. 使變冷；冷藏）
ex: I felt a sudden {chill} when the cold wind blew through the open window, so I put on a sweater.
exz: 冷風從開著的窗戶吹進來，我突然感到一陣寒意，就穿上了毛衣。

ex: The new {dam} on the river provides electricity for the city and helps prevent floods during typhoons.
exz: 河上的新水壩為城市供電，也有助於颱風期間防洪。

ex: The {constant} noise from the construction site next door made it impossible for me to concentrate.
exz: 隔壁工地不斷傳來的噪音讓我完全無法專心。

ex: Ancient Greece is often called the {cradle} of Western civilization because of its art and philosophy.
exz: 古希臘因其藝術與哲學，常被稱為西方文明的發源地。

ex: Africa is the second largest {continent} in the world, and it has more than fifty countries.
exz: 非洲是世界第二大洲，有超過五十個國家。

ex: The boxer was hit so hard that he lost {consciousness} and had to be taken to the hospital.
exz: 那位拳擊手被重擊後失去意識，必須送醫。

zh: 押金；訂金；存款；沉積物（v. 存放；沉積）
ex: To rent the apartment, you have to pay a {deposit} of two months' rent, which you get back when you move out.

zh: 死忠的；頑固的（n. 死忠者；亦拼作 die-hard）

exz: 他是洋基隊的死忠球迷，看了這季每一場比賽，即使球隊一直輸。

ex: The passengers waited on the {dock} for the ferry that would take them to the island.
exz: 乘客在碼頭等候載他們去小島的渡輪。

ex: The light in the old library was so {dim} that we could hardly read the titles of the books.
exz: 舊圖書館的燈光太昏暗，我們幾乎看不清書名。

ex: The car slid off the icy road and landed in a {ditch}, but luckily nobody was hurt.
exz: 車子滑出結冰的路面，掉進水溝，幸好沒人受傷。

zh: 商人；經銷商；（牌局）發牌者

exz: 我爸向當地一家經銷商買了新車，對方給了好價錢和三年免費保養。

zh: 非常；深深地；付出高昂代價地（pay dearly）
ex: She loves her grandmother {dearly} and visits her every weekend at the nursing home, bringing her favorite cakes.
exz: 她深愛奶奶，每個週末都帶著奶奶最愛的蛋糕去安養院探望她。

ex: She has an {enviable} job: she travels around the world and gets paid to write about food.
exz: 她有一份令人羨慕的工作：環遊世界，寫美食還有錢拿。

ex: Water was {dripping} from the ceiling after the heavy rain, so we put a bucket under the leak.
exz: 大雨後天花板一直在滴水，所以我們在漏水處下方放了一個水桶。

zh: 懷疑的；不確定的；可疑的
ex: It is {doubtful} that the game will go on as planned, because a strong typhoon is coming tomorrow.
exz: 比賽能否照原定計畫進行很難說，因為明天有強颱要來。

zh: 排水；瀝乾；耗盡（n. 排水管）
ex: After washing the vegetables, {drain} the water and let them dry for a few minutes before you start cooking.
exz: 洗完菜後，把水瀝乾，等幾分鐘讓菜乾了再開始下鍋。

ex: The lifeguard quickly jumped into the deep pool and saved a little boy who was about to {drown}.
exz: 救生員迅速跳進深水池，救起一個快要溺水的小男孩。

ex: They announced their {engagement} at the family dinner, and they plan to get married next spring.
exz: 他們在家庭聚餐上宣布訂婚，計畫明年春天結婚。

ex: Some people secretly {dump} their garbage on the beach at night, which makes the local residents very angry.
exz: 有些人晚上偷偷把垃圾倒在海灘上，讓當地居民非常生氣。

ex: The government plans to {enact} a new law that will ban plastic straws in all restaurants.
exz: 政府計畫制定一項新法，禁止所有餐廳使用塑膠吸管。

ex: A large {flock} of birds flew over the lake in a V shape, heading south for the winter.
exz: 一大群鳥排成 V 字形飛過湖面，往南方過冬。

ex: Please remember to turn off the {faucet} while you are brushing your teeth, because every drop of water counts.
exz: 刷牙時請記得關掉水龍頭，因為每一滴水都很珍貴。

ex: The bus {fare} from Taipei to Taichung is only about 300 dollars, much cheaper than the high-speed rail.
exz: 台北到台中的客運票價只要大約三百元，比高鐵便宜得多。

ex: Tourists throw coins into the {fountain} in the center of the square and make a wish.
exz: 遊客把硬幣丟進廣場中央的噴泉許願。

ex: Taiwan {exports} computer chips to countries all over the world, and this trade is very important to its economy.

zh: 喜歡的（be fond of）；溫馨的（fond memories）

exz: 爺爺非常喜歡園藝，每天早上都在照顧他的花。

ex: The {flesh} of this fruit is soft and sweet, but the skin is thick and bitter.
exz: 這種水果的果肉軟又甜，但果皮又厚又苦。

ex: Even after losing ten games in a row, the coach never lost {faith} in his young players and kept encouraging them.
exz: 即使連輸十場，教練始終對年輕球員保有信心，不斷鼓勵他們。

zh: 賭博；冒險（n. 冒險、賭注）
ex: He {gambled} away all his savings at the casino and had to borrow money to pay the rent.
exz: 他在賭場把所有積蓄都賭光了，只好借錢付房租。

ex: The police arrested five members of a {gang} that had been stealing motorcycles across the city.
exz: 警方逮捕了一個在全市偷機車的幫派的五名成員。

zh: 一瞥；匆匆一看（at a glance 一眼就）
ex: She took a quick {glance} at her watch and realized that she was going to be late for class.
exz: 她迅速瞄了一眼手錶，發現上課快遲到了。

ex: Sending flowers to the hospital was a kind {gesture} that made the sick old man very happy.
exz: 送花到醫院是個貼心的表示，讓生病的老先生非常開心。

ex: The {gap} between rich and poor has grown wider, and many young people cannot afford to buy a home.
exz: 貧富差距越來越大，許多年輕人買不起房子。

zh: 抓緊；理解、領會（n. 緊握；理解）
ex: It took me a long time to {grasp} the main idea of the article because it used many difficult words.

ex: The hikers spent the night in a small wooden {hut} near the top of the mountain.

ex: Jerusalem is a {holy} city for Jews, Christians, and Muslims, so millions of people visit it every year.
exz: 耶路撒冷是猶太教徒、基督徒和穆斯林共同的聖城，每年有數百萬人造訪。

ex: The farmer gave the horses some {hay} to eat because the grass in the field was covered with snow.
exz: 田裡的草都被雪覆蓋了，所以農夫給馬吃一些乾草。

ex: There was a {heap} of dirty clothes on the floor of his bedroom, and his mother was not happy about it.
exz: 他臥室地上有一堆髒衣服，他媽媽很不高興。

ex: Don't make a {hasty} decision about your future; take some time to think about what you really want.
exz: 別對自己的未來做草率的決定，花點時間想想你真正想要什麼。

ex: If you have any questions about the homework, please don't {hesitate} to ask me or send me an email.

exz: 抽菸不只傷害吸菸者本身，也會間接影響家人的健康。

ex: Many people think it is {immoral} to test cosmetics on animals, so they only buy cruelty-free products.
exz: 許多人認為用動物測試化妝品是不道德的，所以只買零殘忍產品。

ex: The police finally found the real thief, proving that the young man was {innocent} after all.
exz: 警方終於找到真正的小偷，證明那名年輕人終究是清白的。

ex: Every car should carry a first-aid {kit} with bandages and medicine in case of an accident.
exz: 每輛車都應該備有裝著繃帶和藥品的急救箱，以防意外發生。

ex: It is rude to {interrupt} people while they are speaking, so please wait until they finish.

zh: 管理；經營；資方、管理階層

ex: The old roof {leaks} whenever it rains, so we have to put buckets on the floor to catch the water.

ex: The bride's white dress was decorated with delicate {lace} that her grandmother had made by hand.
exz: 新娘的白紗以精緻的蕾絲裝飾，那是她奶奶親手做的。

ex: We had a {marvelous} time in Kyoto, visiting old temples and eating delicious food every day.
exz: 我們在京都玩得很愉快，每天參觀古寺、吃美食。

ex: The {mighty} river flows thousands of kilometers through deserts and forests before it finally reaches the sea.
exz: 這條浩大的河流穿越沙漠與森林數千公里，才終於注入大海。

ex: The floor of the hotel lobby is made of white {marble}, which feels cool even in summer.
exz: 飯店大廳的地板是白色大理石，即使夏天踩起來也很涼。

zh: 道德的；品行端正的（n. 寓意；（-s）品德）

zh: 行動的；可移動的；流動的（n.（英）手機）

exz: 她哥哥高中畢業後加入海軍，現在在一艘大軍艦上工作。

exz: 那位滑板手戴了護膝和安全帽，以防跌倒受傷。

zh: 手術；運作；操作；（軍事）行動

ex: Despite losing the first game, the coach was {optimistic} that his team could still win the championship.
exz: 儘管輸了第一場，教練仍樂觀認為球隊有機會奪冠。

zh: 朋友；夥伴（pen pal 筆友）
ex: I have had a pen {pal} in Japan for five years, and we finally met in person last summer.
exz: 我在日本有一位交往五年的筆友，去年夏天終於見到面。

ex: Both parents work long hours, so they hired a {nanny} to take care of their baby during the day.
exz: 父母都工作很長時間，所以請了保母白天照顧寶寶。

ex: Some stars are so far away that they cannot be seen with the {naked} eye, only with a telescope.
exz: 有些星星太遠，肉眼看不到，只能用望遠鏡看。

ex: The old {nun} has lived in the church for forty years, praying every day and teaching poor children.
exz: 那位老修女在教堂住了四十年，每天祈禱並教導窮苦孩子。

ex: The mailman left a {parcel} at the door, and inside was a birthday present from my aunt in Canada.
exz: 郵差在門口留了一個包裹，裡面是加拿大的阿姨寄來的生日禮物。

ex: Don't {panic} if there is an earthquake; just hide under a table and protect your head.
exz: 地震時別驚慌，只要躲到桌子下保護頭部就好。

zh: 插頭；塞子（v. 插上插頭；堵塞）
ex: The TV suddenly stopped working because the {plug} had come out of the socket when the cat knocked the cable.
exz: 電視突然不能用了，因為貓撞到電線，插頭從插座脫落。

ex: The workers dug a deep {pit} in the ground to bury the garbage from the village.
exz: 工人在地上挖了一個深坑，用來掩埋村裡的垃圾。

ex: After he broke his arm playing basketball, the doctor put it in {plaster} for six weeks.
exz: 他打籃球摔斷手臂後，醫生幫他打了六週石膏。

zh: 一堆；大量（a pile of / piles of）（v. 堆積）
ex: There is a {pile} of books on my desk that I need to return to the library before Friday.
exz: 我桌上有一堆書，週五前得還給圖書館。

fix: 「肖果皮」應為「削果皮」（錯字）；peel 是「剝、削（皮）」。
ex: Could you help me {peel} the apples and cut them into slices while I make the pie crust for dessert?
exz: 我做甜點的派皮時，你可以幫我削蘋果皮、切片嗎？

zh: 可惜的事；同情（It's a pity that…）
ex: It's a {pity} that you can't come to the party; everyone was hoping to see you.
exz: 你不能來派對真可惜，大家都很期待見到你。

ex: Take one {pill} after each meal, and drink plenty of water until you feel better.
exz: 每餐飯後吃一顆藥，並多喝水直到好轉。

zh: 民意調查；投票（v. 對…做民調）
ex: According to a recent {poll}, more than sixty percent of people support the new law on plastic bags.
exz: 根據最近一項民調，超過六成民眾支持新的塑膠袋法規。

ex: She wore a necklace of white {pearls} that her grandmother had given her on her wedding day.
exz: 她戴著一條白珍珠項鍊，那是奶奶在她婚禮當天送的。

ex: Smoking is not {permitted} anywhere inside the hospital building, including the bathrooms and the parking garage.
exz: 醫院大樓內任何地方都禁止吸菸，包括廁所和停車場。

ex: The children drew pictures on the {pavement} with colorful chalk while waiting for the school bus.
exz: 孩子們等校車時，用彩色粉筆在人行道上畫畫。

zh: 鋪（路）（pave the way for 為…鋪路）
ex: The town {paved} the muddy road with stones so that cars could pass even in the rainy season.
exz: 鎮上用石頭鋪好那條泥濘的路，讓車子在雨季也能通行。

fix: puppet 是可操作的「木偶、布偶（戲偶）」或比喻「傀儡」；一般的「玩偶」較常說 doll / stuffed toy。
ex: The children laughed as the {puppet} danced on the stage, moved by strings controlled from above.
exz: 戲偶在台上被上方操控的線牽動跳舞，孩子們看得哈哈大笑。

zh: 幫浦；打氣筒（v. 抽取；打氣）
ex: My bike tire was flat, so I borrowed a {pump} from my neighbor and filled it with air.
exz: 我腳踏車輪胎沒氣了，所以向鄰居借打氣筒打氣。

zh: 奇怪的；古怪的（現代多指同性戀、酷兒）
ex: There was a {queer} smell in the old house, so we opened all the windows to let in fresh air.
exz: 老房子裡有一股奇怪的味道，所以我們打開所有窗戶讓新鮮空氣進來。

ex: A backpack is more {practical} than a handbag for school because it can hold more books.
exz: 上學用背包比手提包實用，因為可以裝更多書。

fix: primarily 是副詞「主要地」；「主要的」是形容詞 primary。
ex: This app is designed {primarily} for high school students who want to improve their English vocabulary.
exz: 這款 App 主要是為想增進英文字彙的高中生設計的。

ex: These {porcelain} cups were made in China more than two hundred years ago and are now worth a fortune.
exz: 這些瓷杯兩百多年前在中國製造，現在價值連城。

ex: In her graduation speech, the principal {quoted} a famous line from Shakespeare to encourage the students to follow their dreams.
exz: 校長在畢業致詞中引用莎士比亞的一句名言，鼓勵學生追求夢想。

fix: purely 是副詞「純粹地、完全地」；「全然的、純粹的」是形容詞 pure。
ex: We met {purely} by chance at the airport; neither of us knew the other was traveling to Tokyo.
exz: 我們純屬巧合在機場相遇，彼此都不知道對方也要去東京。

ex: The small bakery made a {profit} of one million dollars last year, so the owner opened a second shop.
exz: 那家小麵包店去年獲利一百萬元，所以老闆開了第二家店。

ex: Your {presence} at tomorrow's meeting is required, so please do not be late, and bring your report with you.
exz: 你必須出席明天的會議，所以請別遲到，並帶著你的報告。

ex: A large {portrait} of the founder of the school hangs on the wall of the main hall.
exz: 學校創辦人的大幅肖像掛在大禮堂的牆上。

ex: This necklace is made of {pure} gold with nothing else mixed in, so it is very heavy and expensive.
exz: 這條項鍊是純金打造的，沒有摻雜其他東西，所以又重又貴。

ex: Time is {precious}, so don't waste it scrolling through your phone for hours every night.
exz: 時間很寶貴，所以別每晚花好幾個小時滑手機浪費掉。

fix: reasonably 是副詞「相當地、合理地」；「相當的、合理的」是形容詞 reasonable。
ex: The hotel was {reasonably} priced, so we stayed there for a whole week instead of just two nights.
exz: 那家飯店價格相當合理，所以我們住了一整週，而不是只住兩晚。

ex: The bananas are not {ripe} yet; wait until they turn yellow before you eat them.
exz: 香蕉還沒熟，等它們變黃再吃。

fix: remain 是動詞「保持、仍然、剩下」；「遺跡、遺骸」是名詞 remains（要加 s）。
ex: Please {remain} seated with your seat belts fastened until the plane has come to a complete stop at the gate.
exz: 在飛機於登機門完全停妥前，請繫好安全帶留在座位上。

ex: She is very {religious} and goes to church every Sunday morning with her whole family.
exz: 她很虔誠，每週日早上都和全家人上教堂。

ex: My old car is not very fast, but it is {reliable} and has never broken down in ten years.
exz: 我的舊車開不快，但很可靠，十年來從沒故障過。

zh: 遙遠的；偏僻的；（可能性）微小的
ex: Doctors fly to {remote} villages in the mountains to treat people who live far from any hospital.
exz: 醫生搭飛機到山上偏遠的村落，為離醫院很遠的居民看病。

zh: 合理的；（價格）公道的；講理的
ex: The food at this restaurant is delicious, and the prices are {reasonable}, so it is always full of students.
exz: 這家餐廳的食物好吃、價格公道，所以總是擠滿學生。

fix: reveal 是動詞「揭露、透露」，不是形容詞「透露的」。
ex: The singer finally {revealed} on social media that she had been secretly married for two years.
exz: 那位歌手終於在社群媒體上透露，她已經秘密結婚兩年了。

zh: 寬慰；鬆一口氣；（痛苦的）減輕、解除；救濟
ex: It was a great {relief} to hear that everyone on the plane had survived the emergency landing.
exz: 聽到機上所有人都在緊急迫降中生還，真是讓人鬆了一口氣。

ex: Many young people {rely} on their phones to find their way around the city, so they get lost when the battery dies.
exz: 許多年輕人靠手機在城市裡找路，所以手機沒電時就會迷路。

zh: 後悔；遺憾（regret V-ing / to V）
ex: I {regret} not studying harder in high school; now I have to work twice as hard in college.
exz: 我後悔高中沒有更用功，現在上大學得加倍努力。

zh: 代表；代表人（adj. 有代表性的）
fix: representative 當名詞是「代表（人）」，當形容詞是「有代表性的」；只寫「代表性」詞性不清楚。
ex: Each class chose a {representative} to attend the student council meeting and share their ideas with the principal.
exz: 每班選出一名代表出席學生會會議，並向校長分享大家的想法。

ex: The farmer {scattered} seeds across the field by hand and then waited for the spring rain to come.
exz: 農夫用手把種子撒在田裡，然後等待春雨到來。

ex: The earthquake caused damage on a huge {scale}, and the government needed months to repair the roads.
exz: 地震造成大規模的損害，政府花了好幾個月才修好道路。

zh: 緣故；利益（for the sake of 為了…）
fix: sake 是「緣故、利益」（for the sake of 為了…的緣故），不是一般的「理由」（理由是 reason）。
ex: For the {sake} of her health, my mother stopped drinking coffee and started walking every evening.
exz: 為了健康，媽媽戒掉咖啡，開始每晚散步。

ex: It was {sensible} of you to bring an umbrella, because the weather report said it would rain all afternoon.
exz: 你帶傘真是明智，因為氣象預報說整個下午都會下雨。

ex: If you leave the fruit in the hot sun, it will {rot} in just a few days.
exz: 如果把水果放在大太陽下，幾天內就會爛掉。

zh: 螺絲（v. 用螺絲固定；擰）
ex: One {screw} was missing, so the chair was not stable and moved when I sat on it.
exz: 少了一顆螺絲，所以椅子不穩，我一坐就晃。

zh: 令人滿意的；符合要求的
ex: Her grades were {satisfactory}, but her teacher knew she could do even better if she worked harder.
exz: 她的成績還算令人滿意，但老師知道她更努力的話可以表現更好。

ex: The water is {shallow} here, so even small children can stand up in it safely.
exz: 這裡水很淺，所以連小孩都能安全地站在水裡。

ex: The farmer carried a heavy {sack} of rice on his back all the way to the market.
exz: 農夫把一大袋米扛在背上，一路走到市場。

ex: Fresh water is {scarce} in the desert, so people there have to be very careful not to waste it.
exz: 沙漠中淡水很稀少，所以當地人必須非常小心，不能浪費。

ex: She had to {scrub} the kitchen floor for an hour to remove all the grease and dirt.
exz: 她得刷洗廚房地板一小時，才能除去所有油污和髒東西。

ex: If you leave your bike outside in the rain, the chain will {rust} and become hard to pedal.
exz: 如果把腳踏車放在外面淋雨，鏈條會生鏽，變得很難踩。

ex: She {sighed} deeply when she saw the long list of homework the teacher had written on the board.
exz: 她看到老師寫在黑板上長長的作業清單，深深嘆了一口氣。

zh: 苗條的；纖細的；（機會、數量）微小的
fix: slender 主要是「苗條的、纖細的」；只有在 slender chance / slender income 等搭配中才有「微小、少量」之意，單寫「少量」不準確。
ex: The fashion model was tall and {slender}, with long legs and a narrow waist that looked perfect in the dress.
exz: 那位時裝模特兒又高又苗條，長腿細腰，穿那件洋裝完美極了。

ex: Many religions teach that lying, stealing, and hurting others are {sins} that people should try hard to avoid.
exz: 許多宗教教導說，說謊、偷竊和傷害他人都是人們應極力避免的罪。

zh: 惡意；怨恨（in spite of 儘管）
ex: In {spite} of the heavy rain, thousands of fans waited outside the stadium for the concert to begin.
exz: 儘管下著大雨，數千名歌迷仍在體育場外等待演唱會開始。

ex: The whole nation was filled with {sorrow} when the beloved old king passed away after ruling for seventy years.
exz: 在位七十年的敬愛老國王過世時，舉國上下沉浸在悲傷中。

ex: She {sprained} her ankle while playing basketball in gym class and had to use crutches for two weeks.
exz: 她在體育課打籃球時扭傷腳踝，得撐兩週拐杖。

zh: 重要的；顯著的；意義重大的
ex: There has been a {significant} increase in the number of tourists since the new airport opened.
exz: 新機場啟用後，觀光客人數顯著增加。

ex: The store is waiting for a new {shipment} of phones, which should arrive from the factory next week.
exz: 這家店正在等新一批手機，應該下週會從工廠送達。

ex: The rain {spoiled} our picnic, so we had to eat our sandwiches in the car.
exz: 雨破壞了我們的野餐，我們只好在車上吃三明治。

ex: The bread had been on the table for three days, so it was dry and {stale}.
exz: 麵包在桌上放了三天，又乾又不新鮮。

ex: They moved from the city center to a quiet {suburb} where the houses are bigger and the air is cleaner.
exz: 他們從市中心搬到一個安靜的郊區，那裡房子較大、空氣也較乾淨。

ex: If you {subtract} the cost of food and rent from your salary, you will see how little money is left.
exz: 如果把伙食費和房租從薪水中扣掉，你就會發現剩下的錢有多少。

ex: The man was arrested on {suspicion} of stealing cars, but he said he had never been near the parking lot.
exz: 那名男子因涉嫌偷車被捕，但他說自己從未靠近那個停車場。

ex: The cut on his knee was so deep that the doctor had to give him five {stitches}.
exz: 他膝蓋的傷口很深，醫生必須幫他縫五針。

fix: steadily 是副詞「穩定地、持續地」；「漸漸」較接近 gradually，而且副詞中文用「地」不用「的」。
ex: The number of elderly people in Taiwan has been {steadily} increasing for the past twenty years.
exz: 過去二十年來，台灣的老年人口持續穩定增加。

ex: After I twisted my ankle, it began to {swell}, and soon I could not put on my shoe.
exz: 我扭到腳踝後，它開始腫起來，很快就穿不下鞋了。

fix: sufficiently 是副詞「充分地、足夠地」；「充分的」是形容詞 sufficient。
ex: The soup was not {sufficiently} hot, so the customer asked the waiter to warm it up again.
exz: 湯不夠熱，所以客人請服務生再加熱一次。

ex: Without {sufficient} evidence to prove he had stolen the money, the police had to let the man go home.
exz: 由於沒有足夠證據證明他偷了錢，警方只好讓那名男子回家。

zh: 僵硬的；痠痛的；（競爭）激烈的
fix: stiff 主要是「僵硬的、痠痛的」；「激烈的」只用在 stiff competition 這類搭配，不是基本義。
ex: After sitting at my desk studying for six hours, my neck and shoulders felt {stiff} and sore.
exz: 在書桌前讀書六個小時後，我的脖子和肩膀又僵硬又痠痛。

zh: 較好的；優越的；上級的（be superior to）（n. 上司）
ex: This new phone is {superior} to the old model in almost every way, especially its camera.
exz: 這支新手機幾乎在各方面都勝過舊機型，尤其是相機。

zh: 脾氣；情緒（lose one's temper 發脾氣）
ex: My father rarely loses his {temper}, but he got really angry when I came home at 3 a.m.
exz: 我爸很少發脾氣，但我凌晨三點回家時他真的氣炸了。

ex: The old house was built with {timber} from the nearby forest, and it has stood for over a hundred years.
exz: 那棟老房子用附近森林的木材建造，已屹立超過一百年。

ex: We can walk to the small island only at low {tide}, when the water goes down and the path appears.
exz: 我們只有在退潮時才能走到小島，那時海水退去、小路就會出現。

ex: My car broke down on the highway, so a truck had to {tow} it to the nearest garage.
exz: 我的車在高速公路上拋錨，只好讓拖吊車拖到最近的修車廠。

zh: 嫩的；溫柔的；（觸碰時）疼痛的
ex: The beef was cooked so slowly that it became soft and {tender}, and it almost melted in my mouth.
exz: 牛肉燉得很慢，變得又軟又嫩，幾乎入口即化。

zh: 馴服的；溫順的（v. 馴服）
ex: The deer in Nara are so {tame} that they will eat crackers right out of your hand.
exz: 奈良的鹿非常溫馴，會直接從你手上吃餅乾。

zh: 線；（思路的）頭緒、脈絡；（網路）討論串
fix: thread 最基本的意思是「線」；「思緒、頭緒」是引申義（如 lose the thread 失去頭緒）。
ex: She used a needle and some red {thread} to sew the button back onto her shirt.
exz: 她用針和一些紅線把鈕扣縫回襯衫上。

zh: 詩句；詩節；（歌曲的）段落、主歌
ex: The students had to memorize the first two {verses} of the poem for tomorrow's test.
exz: 學生們得為明天的考試背下這首詩的前兩節。

zh: 空的；未被佔用的；（職位）空缺的
ex: There are no {vacant} seats on the train, so we have to stand all the way to Kaohsiung.
exz: 火車上沒有空位，所以我們得一路站到高雄。

fix: 「公會」應為「工會」（labor union）；union 也指「聯盟、結合」，如 the European Union（歐盟）。
ex: The workers' {union} asked the company to raise salaries by five percent and give everyone more paid holidays.
exz: 工會要求公司加薪百分之五，並讓每個人有更多有薪假。

ex: More and more people are moving from the countryside to {urban} areas to look for better jobs.
exz: 越來越多人從鄉村搬到都市地區找更好的工作。

ex: Prices of hotel rooms {vary} from season to season, so it is cheaper to travel in winter.
exz: 飯店房價隨季節而不同，所以冬天旅行比較便宜。

fix: unity 是名詞「團結、一致」，不是形容詞「一致的」。
ex: After the strong earthquake, people across the country showed great {unity} by helping their neighbors rebuild their homes.
exz: 強烈地震後，全國民眾展現高度團結，幫助鄰居重建家園。

zh: 不安的；憂慮的；不自在的
ex: I felt {uneasy} walking home alone on the dark, empty street, so I called my brother to meet me.
exz: 獨自走在黑暗無人的街上回家讓我很不安，所以我打電話請哥哥來接我。

ex: The workers began to {unload} the boxes from the truck as soon as it arrived at the store.
exz: 卡車一到店門口，工人就開始從車上卸下箱子。

ex: The Amis are the largest indigenous {tribe} in Taiwan, and they hold a harvest festival every summer.
exz: 阿美族是台灣人口最多的原住民族，每年夏天都會舉辦豐年祭。

ex: The magician waved his hand, and the rabbit {vanished} from the box in front of everyone's eyes.
exz: 魔術師一揮手，兔子就在眾目睽睽之下從箱子裡消失了。

ex: Every weekend, my grandmother pulls {weeds} in the garden so that her vegetables can grow well.
exz: 每個週末，奶奶都會在菜園裡拔雜草，好讓蔬菜長得好。

ex: The {wealthy} businessman gave millions of dollars to build a new hospital in his hometown.
exz: 那位富有的商人捐了數百萬美元在家鄉蓋一間新醫院。

ex: The minimum {wage} in Taiwan has gone up several times, but many workers say it is still too low.
exz: 台灣的基本工資已調漲好幾次，但許多勞工說還是太低。

ex: The women in the village {weave} colorful baskets from bamboo and sell them at the market.

ex: We spent the whole afternoon {wandering} around the old streets of Tainan, trying different snacks and taking photos.
